## 1. Summary

本 Plan 将完整引擎收敛拆为 **52 个实施步骤、511 个唯一文件路径、656 个有序文件操作块**，覆盖 Service、Components、Web 三个交付仓库。Step 25 依赖 Jianshen 的一条独立兼容纠正，约束见 §6.5。§4.3 给出依赖、subagent 和并行批次；§5 是唯一文件归属清单；§7 按实际依赖给出逐文件伪代码、RED/GREEN、命令、完成条件和提交范围；§10 追踪全部 REQ-001–021、OWN/MOVE/REMOVE、API/SPI/Event 与 TEST-001–018。

先建立注解处理及稳定契约，再推进独立组件、Process/Worker、Agent Runtime 与 Web；共享装配和协议接收端按明确顺序汇合。保留 Flowable 状态权威、现有 Worker/Poller、Outbox/Inbox、历史 SQL/hash 与在途版本。最终通过四类完整流程、真实独立进程/数据库、迁移与故障矩阵形成可复核证据。

用户已授权实施。§6.5 记录了用户确认的合同决定和执行技能允许的保持原意修订。Step 1–51 及 §6.5 并发证据纠正已提交，Step 52 汇总同候选的真实证据。文档中的 `PASS` 表示计划审查结果，产品验收以各 Step 的实际执行证据为准。

## 2. Target Spec and Effective Design

### 2.1 Primary target

主目标为头部唯一 `Implements Spec`。用户于 2026-11-13 明确确认该 Spec 并要求编写 Plan，随后确认“先补齐 Spec，再完成 Plan”。因此 Worker 恢复证据、Memory 无损迁移、专用发布权限及 Agent 终态合同的修订属于本轮授权；当前 Spec 元数据保留 `Review`，本 Plan 同样保持 `Review`，实现以 Plan 审核为前置。

### 2.2 Effective Spec set

| Role | Spec/link | Status/revision | Effective sections | Why included |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary | [完整引擎 Spec](../spec/2026-11-11-18-55-intelligent-process-engine-convergence.md) | 头部记录的当前 Review、Updated 和完整 hash | §1–20 | 全部需求、协议、迁移、Web 与验收 |
| Dependency | [架构主计划](../../../../docs/plans/agent-framework-upgrade-plan.md) | 当前磁盘版本，受主 Spec 保留条款限定 | §6.3、§19 T3-03/04/05 | 普通 JDBC 技术存储、Worker 和 Outbox/Inbox 的原有授权；不恢复旧业务目标 |

### 2.3 Superseded or excluded content

[首段融合 Spec](../spec/2026-11-11-16-56-process-agent-task-fusion.md) 已被主 Spec 整体替代。生产部署、TLS、实际账号赋权、第三方业务仓库、拖拽 BPMN 库、并列 Agent Workflow 引擎及新增计费系统不在本 Plan 范围。删除旧入口需要本 Plan 的消费者与在途恢复证据；不得把这一条件替换成直接删除历史表或原始快照。

## 4. Implementation Strategy and Dependency Order

### 4.1 Ordered strategy

依赖图同时包含能力依赖和文件写入互斥。Service 根构建先行；中立 AF 接口可在 Components 独立进行。C 的 typed/schema/摘要先于三个私有合同分支；OAS 汇合后才完成 Java/Web 消费者。PS 在 V14 verifier、编译器、草稿、发布、生效基础上实现 START 与节点；Worker 在自己 V3 效果收据和既有 Poller 上接入 v2。PS 先接受双版 Agent 终态，AS 才启用新 writer。AR 先交付双版 reader，后采用 V17 与新 profile。Memory 先封口全部旧写者，冻结并排空后再切换唯一权威。业务替代 fixture 先通过，旧业务入口和 Web 页面后退役。

§7 的数字顺序是一个合法拓扑顺序，不要求把所有独立工作串行。只有完成 `Dependencies`、拿到前置提交并验证工作树基线，才可启动该步骤。共享文件后写者依赖前写者；契约变动退回其唯一 owner，再使消费者跟进。

### 4.2 Test-first strategy

每个行为步骤的 File 1 或该行为前置测试块定义实际失败断言，随后写最小实现、装配和回归。新类型可先以测试内 fixture/反射或必要编译前置建立可运行测试；缺类、缺依赖、无法连库、缺凭据不是有效行为 RED。构建步骤先补已有注解依赖，反射测试再证明缺 Qualifier 的 RED；文档步骤只核对已经存在的实现和证据，标明测试先行不适用的原因。不得编写与实际业务路径无关的假实现来制造 GREEN。

跨仓库验收分为静态/纯单元、真实 PostgreSQL、独立 JVM/HTTP、浏览器四类证据。每条明确选择的集成测试都必须有非零用例且无跳过；缺环境停止该步对应的完成门禁，不降低判定。超时、并发、身份、旧版、响应丢失和重启场景与正例同等必要。

### 4.3 Sequential and parallel boundaries

每个实施步骤均明确调用预配置 subagent 的角色与文件范围。主 agent 负责依赖调度、共享文件串行汇合、diff 审查、验证及最终提交；各子 agent 不提交彼此文件，不回退其他人的工作。并行分支必须从同一已确认前置提交出发；同仓并行编辑可以共享工作树，但 Git index/commit、会写同一 target 的 Maven、npm build/permission 生成必须由主 agent 串行。跨仓验证可并行。

### 4.4 Commit boundaries

每个 Step 对应一个仓库的一次语义提交，§7 `Commit paths` 是完整允许路径。主 agent 在验证通过后逐路径暂存并审查 staged diff，不执行 `git add .`。Components 与 Service 的依赖通过已提交且验证的本地 Maven 制品/源码 reactor 连接，不混为一个跨仓提交。初始两份未跟踪 Spec 及本轮文档、用户其他工作均不得被实现提交顺带收录；最终证据文档仅在最后一步按单独范围提交。任何实际仓库规约要求的差异须在执行前核对。

### 4.8 User-mandated Java Rule Implementation Matrix

以下为本任务使用的原始规则，文字与编号保持原样。主 Spec §6.1/6.2 对既有技术JDBC/Flyway的明确例外由用户确认，不扩展为新业务持久化豁免。

```text
1 类名规范，必须以 java的pojo规范命名。以dao po bo vo dto query command event等结尾
2 每层之间必须被 springboot-validation 校验，复用对象使用分组校验；基于原生和自定义约束注解、@Valid、@Validated 及 ConstraintValidator 扩展实现。ValidationUtils 只承担通用手工校验，不承载全部业务校验；电话号码复用 libphonenumber。
3 Java POJO 默认使用 class，注解为 @Data @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor @Accessors(chain = true)，按构造目标选择 @Builder 或 @SuperBuilder；父类状态参与相等性时使用 @EqualsAndHashCode(callSuper = true)。只有不可变 value object 可以使用 record，并豁免 class 的 Lombok 规范；普通实体不能因简单而使用 record。使用 MapStruct、MapStructPlus 和 egon-cola-component-common-core 的 BaseConverter（双向）或 BaseForwardConverter（不可逆投影）进行转换。
4业务类必须使用@Slf4j注解注入log对象。如果业务类被spring管理，必须指定名称，如果是单例的情况下，参考@Service("userService")。如果需要依赖注入，必须@RequiredArgsConstructor进行修饰，不要代码中写。且属性必须被@qualify修饰。
5 工具类只允许使用jdk原生、Apache Commons(commons-lang3、commons-collections4、commons-io、commons-text、commons-codec、commons-beanutils)、Guava。针对Tika按需引入。
6 JSON 使用 Spring Boot Jackson；持久化枚举值使用 @EnumValue，向前端输出的枚举值使用 @JsonValue，禁止 ordinal 作为业务编码。
7 springboot 多环境配置文件，必须保持配置一致，但值不一定一致。
9 复杂业务必须引入设计模式，不允许硬编码
10 日期相关的必须使用java.time下的实体类，不允许使用java.util下的
11 只允许现有三层结构或当前 egon-cola-archetypes 的 DDD 结构，三层结构保持现状。必须尽量复用 egon-cola-components；持久化模块必须使用 Egon COLA MP Starter，DDL 统一由 egon-mp-sdj-ext-starter 分布式管理。业务唯一键必须组合业务列与 deletedAt（数据库 deleted_at），并验证 NULL、租户及重复软删除语义。采用 CQE（Command Query Event）；Event 必须经 egon-cola-component-transactional-outbox-starter 或 MQ 中间件投递。
```

### 4.9 Time semantics and conversion contract

Time contract: Required

| Time ID | Fields/symbols | Semantics | Java/runtime type | Storage policy | Wire policy | Business zone source | Display zone source | Boundary / DST rules | Precision / Clock | Compatibility | Verification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TIME-001 | createdAt/occurredAt/receivedAt/deadlineAt/closedAt/finishedAt | Occurred instant | Instant；JDBC边界OffsetDateTime | UTC instant | UTC Z | Not applicable: 绝对时刻 | Spec§6.3用户显式时区/现有显示策略 | deadline相等即过期；occurredAt不延长接纳；无系统默认时区推断 | DB clock_timestamp微秒，边界统一截断 | 原v1解析与hash不改 | Step 3/Step 25/Step 28/Step 32/Step 11/Step 21/Step 42；TEST-004/005/012 |
| TIME-002 | node/attempt/tool timeout、retryDelay、interval | Duration | Duration | Duration | Duration | Not applicable: 持续时间 | Not applicable: 按合同单位 | retry不重置nodeDeadline；多层取剩余最小值；本地等待单调计时 | 毫秒与有界等待，Clock可控 | 不重新解释旧token时限 | Step 27/Step 28/Step 29/Step 8/Step 21；TEST-003/006/011 |
| TIME-003 | schedule.startAt/endAt | Occurred instant | Instant | UTC instant | UTC Z | 显式业务时区先转换为绝对时刻 | 用户选择时区 | 固定interval/UTC边界；禁止cron和DST猜测 | DB微秒与持久next-fire | 不补历史fire、不改变发布版本 | Step 33；TEST-005 |
| TIME-004 | typed DATE | Pure date | LocalDate | Pure date | Pure date | 定义声明的业务日期语义 | 原日期，不转时区 | 日期合法性校验；不按时刻位移 | 日精度；Not applicable: 无时钟取值 | 不把旧STRING自动变date | Step 3/Step 40；TEST-002 |

## 6. Prerequisites, Constraints, and Plan Clarifications

### 6.1 Repository and worktree baseline

外层 Stellar-Enclosure 是多仓容器。头部三仓 SHA 为本轮源码盘点基线；开始实施每步先核对本仓 `git status --short` 与 `git rev-parse HEAD`，与已完成前置提交逐一对应。初始 Service 已有两份未跟踪 Spec，Web/Components 干净；本轮新增本Plan、修改已授权Spec，未改源码。用户给定AGENTS约束和本技能要求同时适用；使用预配置角色，保护其他工作。

后续生成文件只作为构建产物验证，不手写 target/generated-sources。当前改变的是既有技术结构的 ALTER/显式技术表及人工写入代码，不属于支持的业务 CRUD 初始生成：不运行新模块/archetype/MP-SDJ codegen，不虚构 GENERATED 路径。immutable历史脚本和当前schema history保持。

### 6.2 Build, test, and environment prerequisites

| Concern | Exact command/source | Required state | Validation boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Java/Maven | `JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 25)`；仓库 `./mvnw -v` | JDK25，当前wrapper与已有BOM；不改全局环境或settings | 工具链与编译，不证明运行接受 |
| Service源码reactor | `scripts/verify-source-reactor.sh`，每步精确 `-Dtest` 与 `-DskipTests=false` | 前置制品已提交；选中各类实际非零，读取Surefire汇总 | 单元/合同；PG测试另见每步property |
| Components模块 | `./mvnw -pl stellar-enclosure-component-agent-flow-starter -am ... test` | 原依赖不升级；可选依赖按Spec范围 | 组件/缺类；有PG时才计迁移 |
| Web | `node --version`、`npm ci`、`npm test -- ...`、`npm run build` | Node24、当前lockfile；PAC生成串行 | Vitest/类型/构建；浏览器另做验收 |
| PostgreSQL | 每步列出精确sysprop与宿主已供给SQL；脚本只读取私有fixture manifest | 独立可销毁测试库、有限权限、真实版本与扩展；凭据不入文档/日志 | FK/CHECK/并发/锁/原子性与物理删除 |
| 独立进程 | Step 46的三个test main/manifest与脚本 | PS/AS/W独立PID与三库、同候选JAR、真实readiness、可信凭据 | 网络/中断/恢复/权限行为，不由单库事务替代 |
| 真实权限/消费者 | Spec§15精确resource key与fixture当前许可 | PUBLISH/ACTIVATE/START/template/Worker/Agent权限分别有效 | mock只证明分支，实际IAM和业务上线需环境证据 |

### 6.3 Immutable constraints and approved decisions

保留 v1 wire字段、静态工件和golden字节；新v2禁止向旧strict decoder追加字段。旧release、原始snapshot、SQL历史和receipt摘要不改写。正式START由服务端选当前activation，原命令与旧实例继续原绑定。PS/AS各自事务，网络证明在锁外，提交前再核验本地guard、revision、deadline与proof。UNKNOWN默认等待权威查证，无普通404/自报未执行推导。业务正文/表单/凭据不混入技术日志或浏览器持久缓存。Memory切换不得遗失合法旧scope/原命令返回，旧物理向量及被遗忘正文必须满足Spec红改边界。

### 6.4 Plan Clarifications

| ID | Small implementation inference | Repository evidence | Why semantics are unchanged | Impact if wrong |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PLAN-CLAR-001 | 将Spec验收拆为多个聚焦测试类与test-only独立main | 现有acceptance包、ExpenseAcceptanceHarness和test源码classpath | 仅把既定TEST场景变成可运行入口，不新增产品API | 调整测试文件分工，行为验收不变 |
| PLAN-CLAR-002 | Service根构建前置与PS/AR生成器分步 | 父compiler已有Lombok；Components/邻仓已有Qualifier/MapStruct做法 | 执行Spec明确注解方案，使用已有版本与BOM | 先修构建前置，不放宽注解/模块边界 |
| PLAN-CLAR-003 | Web页面名称映射为ProcessDefinitionWorkspacePage/ProcessDraftEditorPage等 | Spec§8/12与现有页面目录/路由 | 保持已批准职责/URL/resource keys，仅明确落地文件名 | 对应测试和路由一起调整，不增业务页面 |
| PLAN-CLAR-004 | 临时验收shell位于scripts/work并在最终步骤晋升 | 当前scripts/acceptance与旧独立验收范式 | 维护归属变化，不增加产品职责或部署授权 | 晋升失败则最后一步不能完成 |
| PLAN-CLAR-005 | 三仓唯一文件清单记录首次与后续修改者 | 相同security/config/schema verifier反复被多个能力消费 | 只是明确互斥和提交顺序，不改变接口 | 若实际冲突，主agent重排依赖并重验受影响步骤 |
| PLAN-CLAR-006 | Spec§8列入权限变更面的permission-manifest.config.json只验证现有内容 | 当前console.entryPoints已精确列出permissions.ts/resources.ts/messages.ts/references.ts，ownedKeyPrefixes已含app/menu/page/button | 四件套新增/退役资源均由当前入口收集，不需要配置写入；Step 45/Step 48仍实际运行PAC构建核验 | 若构建发现入口遗漏则回查实际变更面，不扩大依赖或擅改权限语义 |

- 新增归属 AR 两个已有测试 `infrastructure/memory/MemoryMigrationIT.java` 和 `application/memory/MemoryPreferenceAdmissionTest.java`。先写实际可运行的行为 RED，再实库复跑 LEGACY→COMPONENT 前后同命令三种原状重放、拒绝新命令/错误摘要、不 materialize 历史 scope、账本及 Outbox 零新增；同步偏好逐项完整性与原授权覆盖正负例。使用与 HTTP V9 和 Runtime V16→V17 测试分开的第三座已授权临时 loopback PostgreSQL 库及其原 exact pgvector/Outbox V1。共享 reactor 由父代理串行，测试前确认证据与 no-skip。
- 旧直启预检还确认了现有 Run 入库和 USER grant 发放独立。上线启用 false 前盘点已受理且 grant 未落库、失效、待重发原键的 USER Run 和固定 codeRef，保留已批准的旧模板及在途处理器配置。Step 46 的两租户本地实际交接允许仓库 base YAML 进入 false；运行环境的存量校验与操作保持由其操作者负责。

#### Step 46 独立子进程配置隔离纠正

Step 47 的真实 Agent V9 `WebApplicationContextRunner` 显示 ComponentScan 提前发现 Step 46 的子进程专用 `@TestConfiguration`，因缺少私有 Settings 提供者而中止。Process 的同型 test main 有相同外溢面。按规则 14 暂存 Step 47 的候选于其原工作树，既有生产改动不进入此纠正。仅 Step 46 `AutomationAgentAcceptanceMain.java` 与 `AutomationProcessAcceptanceMain.java` 上下文增加显式测试 profile，真实 launcher 在以清理后的独立环境启动时启用它，普通应用和旧 ContextRunner 不启用。来源制品、许可、配置值、网络和 SQL 合同不变。独立提交 `test(tianji): isolate independent service fixture configuration`。复验普通 Spring 入口与真实子进程；Step 46 消费者纠正与 Step 52 复用全套验收。

#### Step 46、Step 48 业务承接证据和 Web 消费闭包纠正

- Step 46 原独立验收在 `9cca87b` 实际通过七项，人工夹具只在 Worker 库的业务表保存 `fixture_choice`，同时向引擎提交 `decision` 与引用。Spec §16 明确要求可执行业务消费者保存表单、意见和附件，只将 `resultRef` 提交引擎。先补实际原生结果只含 `resultRef`、当前候选待办查询与跨租户拒绝的断言，再由既有 `AutomationIndependentServicesIT.java` 与 `AutomationAcceptanceHarness.java` 在业务库一并保存并复读实际意见和附件、引用及原表单，按同一业务范围核对。真实授权、原命令回执、生产 DDL 和其余四类流程与故障用例保持。两个原 Step 46 路径独立纠正提交，必须完成真实独立服务和 PostgreSQL 证明才解锁 Step 48。
- Step 48 的静态闭包还包括 `tianji-web/src/App.test.tsx`。现有三个 mock 指向将删除的页面，多个正向断言只服务旧 Task 资源与调用。增加该既有测试路径，保留 Step 45 的静态直达旧书签、零 API 和认证读取、合法返回入口权限、无标识泄露、当前 Case 及 Process-only 观察证明。修改测试在删除源模块前执行。本项将 Step 48 扩至 39 路径，另合并下方的浏览器直启闭包；不新增 Web 权限或依赖。前置顺序 Step 45 → Step 48 及 Step 46 consumer 纠正 → Step 48。

#### Step 48 浏览器旧 Agent 直启闭包纠正

Step 47 关停默认的旧直启新请求后，`AgentRunsPage.tsx` 仍拥有可见的“启动运行”、随机新命令键与旧 AS POST，既违反 Spec §3 REMOVE-02 的业务入口退役，又会稳定发送不可回放的新键。现有四件套同时清理仅该按钮的权限、资源、双语标签和浏览器 CALLS。补入 §5/§7 的 `AgentRunsPage.tsx` 及测试、`AgentFlow.test.tsx`、`src/api/agent.ts` 及测试、`AuthContext.test.tsx` 和共享 `fixtures.ts` 七个文件。列表、分页、详情、SSE、取消、tenant/epoch、Case 与 Process v2 START 均继续验证；旧 AS 同身份已提交回执保留。App 的旧 Task/Memory 书签仍按 Step 45 静态行为验证。Step 48 共 46 个路径，先验证正向旧直启将消失的测试，再移除独用 wrapper 和清零四件套，移除任何测试模仿新创建旧 Run 的路径。

#### Step 26 并发与微秒边界证据纠正

Spec TEST-007 和 Step 52 要求真实 PostgreSQL 与 Flowable 的一百次取消、结果和 timer 竞争以及硬截止微秒等值。当前 `AutomationConcurrencyIT.java` 覆盖一次取消/结果竞争、已过期回报和关闭额度，尚无法证明上述两项。以原 Step 26/30 的同一测试路径进行 Step 26 独立纠正。复用原生 guard、真实任务和 timer，使用相互独立的事务及 PostgreSQL 阻塞观察证明每轮竞争，轮换取消、结果和 timer 获锁顺序，断言无双推进、孤儿 job、锁错误、新收据或终态后准入。测试夹具从实际同库 `timestamptz(6)` 截止行读取等值及相邻一微秒，驱动原生产写入和 timer 分支。生产时钟、Schema、接口与原测试语义维持。真实实库通过的当前报告在 Step 52 审核，不用过期近似当等值。

#### Step 28、Step 29 Worker 报工与恢复并发证据纠正

TEST-017 要求同租约同命令并发报工、完整长错误码投影，以及权威复核期间实例被取消后的旧证明拒绝。当前 Step 28 原测试证明原回执串行重放、短错误码和安全重试。Step 46 另证明真实 ACK 丢失后按原键恢复。Step 29 原测试已证明权威查询在根锁之外，未覆盖同根在该查询窗口内取消。使用原 Step 28、Step 29 两个既有测试范围进行各自独立的测试纠正，安排在 Step 51 和 TEST-007 纠正通过后、Step 52 最终验证之前。生产接口、业务协议、已应用数据库版本及责任保持。

- Step 28 仅修改 `stellar-enclosure-tianji-process-server/src/test/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianji/process/server/worker/AutomationWorkerReportingIT.java`。用真实 PostgreSQL 第三连接持有该 V14 根的锁，确认两个独立报工会话均等待同一根后放行，断言同 lease、同 command 返回原 DTO 和微秒 `decidedAt`，持久命令、租约、结果和原生完成作业唯一。保留原 V1/V2、改摘要冲突、丢回执和晚到履约。另在现有外部效果模型加合法 128 字符 `UNKNOWN` 错误码用例，V14 读取完整原值，V4 只读固定 `V2_EFFECT_UNKNOWN`，仅改第 128 字符得到原幂等冲突。原 `RETRYABLE` 用例保留。真实全类 PostgreSQL 报告必须非零全通过，再提交 `test(process): verify concurrent report and error projection`。
- Step 29 仅修改 `stellar-enclosure-tianji-process-server/src/test/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianji/process/server/worker/AutomationWorkerRecoveryIT.java`。使用独立真实 Process、Worker、目标数据库取得仍有效的 `NOT_APPLIED_FINAL` 证明，在权威回调阻塞且同根未被复核锁持有时提交实际取消，再释放原证明。断言版本冲突、一个原尝试仍按取消终结、原报工回执可读、无新增恢复命令、原生 job 或业务效果代次。保留原已执行、权威拒绝、过期、竞争恢复及 HTTP 回归。真实全类 PostgreSQL 报告必须非零全通过，再提交 `test(process): reject recovery proof after concurrent cancellation`。

#### Step 52 最终追溯与 V18 表设计补正

最终静态审查发现主 Spec 已按用户确认把旧 Memory 命令收据纳入 V18 清单，原补订缺少该表详细设计和 ER 关联，严格 Spec 校验报两项。按已确认合同和现有 V10/V18 SQL 补全 Spec §11.2.17/§11.3，并以严格验证复查，不更动历史迁移、数据访问或 API。Plan §10 同时补全 Spec §19 已列、原 Plan 遗漏的 REQ-001/002/008/013/015 对 TEST 追溯。既定用例、门禁与提交范围均保留，原本未跟踪的本地 Plan/Spec 不进入 Step 52 提交。

#### Steps 21、22 终审测试夹具纠正

Step 52 首轮复跑实际暴露两处旧单测夹具与已提交实现漂移，同组真实 PostgreSQL RuntimeSafetyReceiptIT、RuntimeCompatibilityIT 及 ToolActionProfileIT 已通过。按规则 14 暂存本步脚本晋升，依原 Step 分两条测试提交，再恢复最终候选审计。两个用例组维持原门禁强度，生产 Java、既有 SQL、依赖、配置、权限和 wire 范围不变。

- Step 22 的 `stellar-enclosure-tianji-agent-runtime/src/test/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianji/agent/infrastructure/persistence/ToolActionIntentStoreTest.java` 原归 Step 4。现有 LEGACY 测试使用依赖旧 SQL 空白的锁断言，V17 测试还使用任意摘要和未装配的不可变快照查询。仅规范断言空白，复用生产 codec 生成同一受权主体的独立 origin/dispatch 固定事实、精确回执和合法形状漂移负例。复跑 Step 4 完整选集与 Step 22 真实 PostgreSQL 组，独立提交 `test(agent-runtime): align tool intent fixtures with runtime evidence`。

终审记录首次失败和纠正后结果。若以上范围之外的产品、试验源与启动参数保持同一字节，先前通过组可按相同输入引用原报告；纠正涉及的整组重新运行，当前制品及三个独立进程验收使用最终提交候选。

#### Step 46 最终独立运行轮询纠正

Step 52 再次从已打包候选运行七项时，六项通过。业务事件的 API-008 原回执 GET 遇一次精确的 `503/TIANJI_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE`，测试在初次错误退出。隔离 PostgreSQL 同一 SIGNAL 随后为 APPLIED，尝试计数为 0，原订阅一次消费，节点 typed 结果已存并正常结案。有效 OpenAPI 对暂不可核验的依赖或当前权限证据定义该应答。Step 46 已有用于同键操作和状态观察的有界轮询，仅接受该临时错误。将同一单一有界循环用于等待真实终态的 API-008 GET。维持精确回执、发布版本、原生和业务效果的全部断言，其它错误仍立即失败。只改已拥有的 `stellar-enclosure-tianji-process-server/src/test/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianji/process/server/acceptance/AutomationIndependentServicesIT.java`，由主代理实跑单一真实业务事件后独立提交 `test(tianji): bound retries for event receipt polling`。最终独立运行和制品重新锁定到提交候选，未变输入的原 Java 矩阵凭字节等同引用。

## 7. Ordered File-by-file Implementation Steps

每步文件序号均为执行顺序。文件级伪代码中的省略仅针对已在同块明确命名的辅助步骤，不允许以“后续自行设计”替代Spec合同。提交前必须关闭该步列出的Manual Checks；真实环境门禁未运行时保留未完成状态。

### Step 1 — 建立可验证的注解处理与构造注入基线

- Requirements: `REQ-009`, `REQ-014`, `REQ-016`, `REQ-017`, `REQ-018`
- Dependencies: None。按§4.3共同写入文件的前后提交排序。
- Baseline state: Service父级配置Lombok处理器但六模块没有直接Lombok API依赖；Service根无lombok.config；PS无MapStruct处理器，permission-producer另有append处理器链。
- Observable outcome: 新DTO/BO与具名Bean的既定注解可编译，生成构造函数真实携带Autowired与Qualifier，MapStruct真实生成toTarget映射。
- End state: 仅提供既定规范的构建能力和有效RED/GREEN证明；未开放任何v2业务入口。
- Test-first gate: Required — File1/2先建立编译前置；File3首次可运行测试因生成构造参数缺Qualifier而RED；不能把缺依赖的编译错误记作行为RED。File4后同断言GREEN。
- Manual Checks: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-DEP-001, MC-NAME-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-MODEL-001, MC-CONVERT-001, MC-LOG-001, MC-BEAN-001, MC-UTIL-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-TIME-001, MC-CONFIG-001, MC-PATTERN-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001
- Literal Rules: Rule 1, Rule 2, Rule 3, Rule 4, Rule 5, Rule 6, Rule 7, Rule 9, Rule 10, Rule 11
- Subagent execution: 主agent独占本步根构建文件；调用预配置 `java-architect` subagent并行执行Step 2，两个仓库文件不相交；本步完成并提交后才启动Service消费者。
- Parallel ownership: 本步由主agent串行处理Service根build与PS POM；同时可调用AF subagent独占Components的Step 2，不共享文件。所有Service写者必须等待本步提交，不并行覆盖根POM或lombok.config。
- Ordered files:

#### File 1 — `MODIFY pom.xml`

- Purpose: 将已选Lombok API提供给实际编译，而不是只存在于processor classpath。
- Symbols: dependencies、mapstruct.version、lombok.mapstruct.binding.version。
- Repository evidence: 当前Service根六模块聚合；Stellar-Enclosure-Parent/platform-parent的compiler配置仅提供processor；Shoubing根已用MapStruct1.6.3/binding0.2.0。
- Dependencies and consumers: 所有六个Service模块继承；C只获得provided注解，不获得Spring/数据库/ADK。
- Why now: 后续所有普通POJO与具名Bean遵循已确认的Lombok规范，先使模板和测试可编译。
- Contract/signature changes: 添加org.projectlombok:lombok provided，版本使用既有lombok.version=1.18.46；两项processor版本属性复用当前平台版本。
- Input/output and state mapping: 现有BOM版本→编译classpath；不进入运行时传递依赖，不改各模块现有GAV。
- Error and edge behavior: 不覆盖当前dependencyManagement、Boot/ADK版本和permission-producer配置；effective POM若不是锁定版本立即返回本文件。
- Standards impact: MC-DEP-001/BEAN-001/MODEL-001；这是既定注解方案的compile前置，不声明额外运行框架。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 3 full Lombok class构造可生成；Rule 4 构造注入实际可编译；Rule 11 模块架构与原ordinary JDBC不变。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```xml
<properties>
  <!-- 保留全部原属性；新增两项既有平台版本 -->
  <mapstruct.version>1.6.3</mapstruct.version>
  <lombok.mapstruct.binding.version>0.2.0</lombok.mapstruct.binding.version>
</properties>
<dependencies>
  <dependency>
    <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId><artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
    <version>${lombok.version}</version><scope>provided</scope>
  </dependency>
</dependencies>
```

- Verification contribution: File3生成构造器/模型构造断言，以及原ClientDependencyBoundaryTest禁止引擎类型的断言。
- After this file: Lombok API和父processor版本一致；仍无Qualifier复制规则，File3应暴露该缺口。

#### File 2 — `MODIFY stellar-enclosure-tianji-process-server/pom.xml`

- Purpose: 为Spec规定的PS BaseForwardConverter提供真正的生成器，并保持PAC producer链。
- Symbols: mapstruct依赖、maven-compiler-plugin.annotationProcessorPaths、permission-producer append。
- Repository evidence: PS当前通过Outbox/common-core复用BaseForwardConverter；其compiler profile只追加Jianshen processor；Shoubing starter已有Boot/Lombok/binding/MapStruct共同链。
- Dependencies and consumers: ProcessDraftConverter/AutomationActivationConverter/AutomationInstanceConverter/ProcessNodeExecutionConverter；本步只用测试内ProbeConverter证实生成。
- Why now: 在任何业务converter文件前验证编译链，防止后续生成代码缺字段或覆盖权限processor。
- Contract/signature changes: 显式org.mapstruct:mapstruct:${mapstruct.version} provided；追加binding0.2.0与mapstruct-processor1.6.3；保留原Boot和Lombok processor及PAC profile append。
- Input/output and state mapping: 有Lombok getter的SourceBO→生成的ProbeConverter.toTarget→TargetDTO；不让Mapper成为HTTP公开模型。
- Error and edge behavior: 不手写generated-sources实现，不改原target/classes权限工件；effective processor合并或toTarget为空字段均阻止提交。
- Standards impact: MC-CONVERT-001/DEP-001/BEAN-001；Egon BaseForwardConverter单向投影，componentModel=spring，生成源属于构建输出。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 3 使用现有Egon转换接口和MapStruct；Rule 4 保留Spring装配；Rule 11 复用原模块/producer，不加新层。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>org.mapstruct</groupId><artifactId>mapstruct</artifactId>
  <version>${mapstruct.version}</version><scope>provided</scope>
</dependency>
<plugin>
  <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
  <configuration>
    <annotationProcessorPaths combine.children="append">
      <path><groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId><artifactId>lombok-mapstruct-binding</artifactId><version>${lombok.mapstruct.binding.version}</version></path>
      <path><groupId>org.mapstruct</groupId><artifactId>mapstruct-processor</artifactId><version>${mapstruct.version}</version></path>
    </annotationProcessorPaths>
  </configuration>
  <!-- 既有permission-producer/default-compile的append不移除 -->
</plugin>
```

- Verification contribution: File3映射实际值；后续权限生产者构建仍输出原manifest/evidence。
- After this file: 测试mapper可生成；构造参数Qualifier问题仍必须由实际RED证明。

#### File 3 — `CREATE stellar-enclosure-tianji-process-server/src/test/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianji/process/server/AutomationBuildContractTest.java`

- Purpose: 通过真实生成字节码而非源码字符串检查构造注入和转换。
- Symbols: generatedConstructorRetainsAutowiredAndQualifier、generatedConverterReadsLombokProperties；测试内ProbeService/ProbeSourceBO/ProbeTargetDTO/ProbeConverter。
- Repository evidence: 原ProcessStorageConfigurationTest使用JUnit5与Spring装配断言；BaseForwardConverter真实方法为toTarget；Service根当前缺copyableAnnotations。
- Dependencies and consumers: File1/2编译前置，后续全体具名Bean/转换器的工具链门禁；所有探针仅在src/test，不注册到实际应用。
- Why now: 在根lombok.config写入前实际得到缺Qualifier的可运行RED。
- Contract/signature changes: 两个无网络/无数据库测试；真实Autowired构造和Qualifier参数反射；两个不同类型的字段映射断言。
- Input/output and state mapping: ProbeSourceBO(name="draft",revision=7)→ProbeTargetDTO相同值；constructor参数Clock必须有probeClock的Qualifier。
- Error and edge behavior: 无Qualifier、双构造器、字段漏映射或手写generated类均失败；不扫描无关既有手写类并逼迫全仓改造。
- Standards impact: MC-BEAN-001/MODEL-001/CONVERT-001/TEST-001；具体注解方案由编译/反射证明，不以“一个构造器可自动注入”替代显式Autowired。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 1 BO/DTO语义；Rule 3 全Lombok；Rule 4 具名Bean+Slf4j+RequiredArgsConstructor(onConstructor_=@Autowired)+Qualifier；Rule 10 Clock；Rule 11 测试模块边界。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
@Slf4j @Service("probeService") @RequiredArgsConstructor(onConstructor_ = @Autowired)
static class ProbeService { @Qualifier("probeClock") private final Clock clock; }
@Data @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor @Accessors(chain=true) @Builder
static class ProbeSourceBO { private String name; private long revision; }
@Data @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor @Accessors(chain=true) @Builder
static class ProbeTargetDTO { private String name; private long revision; }
@AnnotateWith(value = org.springframework.stereotype.Component.class,
    elements = @AnnotateWith.Element(strings = "probeConverter"))
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring") interface ProbeConverter extends BaseForwardConverter<ProbeSourceBO,ProbeTargetDTO> {
    ProbeTargetDTO toTarget(ProbeSourceBO value);
}
@Test void generatedConstructorRetainsAutowiredAndQualifier() {
    var constructor = ProbeService.class.getDeclaredConstructor(Clock.class);
    assertNotNull(constructor.getAnnotation(Autowired.class));
    assertEquals("probeClock", constructor.getParameters()[0].getAnnotation(Qualifier.class).value());
}
@Test void generatedConverterReadsLombokProperties() {
    var converter = Mappers.getMapper(ProbeConverter.class);
    assertEquals("probeConverter", converter.getClass().getAnnotation(org.springframework.stereotype.Component.class).value());
    var target = converter.toTarget(new ProbeSourceBO("draft",7));
    assertEquals("draft",target.getName()); assertEquals(7,target.getRevision());
}
```

- Verification contribution: `-Dtest=AutomationBuildContractTest,ClientDependencyBoundaryTest`；必须记录首次可运行Qualifier失败和后续通过。
- After this file: 根配置仍缺时Qualifier断言RED；生成mapper本身必须已可编译，否则先返回File1/2而不是记RED成功。

#### File 10 — `CREATE stellar-enclosure-tianji-contract/src/main/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianji/contract/orchestration/automation/ProcessTypedJson.java`

- Purpose: 为多端摘要提供同一个无框架规范字节实现。
- Symbols: `ProcessTypedJson`
- Repository evidence: C已有 OrchestrationRequestDigests 与AgentTerminalEvent的长度前缀摘要；旧算法与方法不动。
- Dependencies and consumers: PS编译与实例、CL原始START摘要、AR终态、W结果摘要。
- Why now: 本文件在RED之后落地，接入本步骤现有类型与后续消费者；当前只处理ProcessTypedJson责任。
- Contract/signature changes: 新增canonicalBytes(Object)及sha256(domain, segments...)内部复用方法；不添加JSON解析器。 黄金 originalStart 固定 definitionKey=autoFlow、businessKey=order-101、correlationId=corr-101；variables含10→十、2→二、amount→原字面、é→换行、U+10000→true、U+E000→null；agentNode.templateRef={key:template,version:999999999999999,contentSha256:64个a}。 V2_MAX_WIRE_INTEGER = 999999999999999L，validateTypedIntegerLeaves检查业务typed树；通用规范编码允许宿主精确long身份字段，按闭合wire结构逐位置校验。API-004/025与TS共用startRequestSha256：对实际将发送的闭合JSON树在schema校验前使用域AUTOMATION_START_REQUEST_V2；依次覆盖definitionKey、businessKey、correlationId、variables、agentTaskOverrides。仅overrides省略时归一{}，显式null拒绝。decimal字符串保留原字面，resolved摘要另由宿主按发布schema归一scale。commandId是独立键，actor/tenant来自服务端。
- Input/output and state mapping: 仅接收宿主严格解析后的Map/List/String/精确整数/Boolean/null；object按未转义键的UTF-16 code unit顺序直接发射，Java String.compareTo与JS默认sort对齐；禁止Web排序后重建普通对象再JSON.stringify。数组原序，整数十进制无前导零且负零为0；保留显式null/Unicode和原始字符串，resolved路径按schema执行decimal scale。字符串只转义双引号、反斜线和控制字符；五个控制字符用短转义，其余U+0001..001F用小写四位转义；slash、中文、U+2028/U+2029、合法补充平面直接UTF-8。H对domain和每个段分别写unsigned32大端字节长度及该段UTF-8，无BOM或尾随空白。
- Error and edge behavior: 拒绝浮点、未配对surrogate、U+0000、非string键、超界深度/长度和未支持对象；新v2 typed位置拒绝绝对值超过999999999999999的整数；全信封的tenant等身份保持宿主原有精确long范围。不记录业务数据。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-UTIL-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-TIME-001
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 5、Rule 6、Rule 10、Rule 11：JDK规范字节与摘要，解析仍由宿主Jackson，旧digest不修改。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
byte[] canonicalBytes(Object boundedTree) {
    requireExactIntegralClosedTree(boundedTree);
    return emitDirectlyToUtf8(boundedTree);
}
void emitObject(Map<String, Object> object, JsonByteWriter writer) {
    writer.beginObject();
    for (String key : object.keySet().stream().sorted(String::compareTo).toList()) {
        writer.writeMember(minimalEscapeWithoutReplacement(key));
        emitValue(object.get(key), writer);
    }
    writer.endObject();
}
String sha256(String domain, byte[]... utf8Segments) {
    var digest = sha256Digest();
    updateU32BigEndianLengthAndBytes(digest, utf8Strict(domain));
    for (byte[] segment : utf8Segments) updateU32BigEndianLengthAndBytes(digest, segment);
    return lowerHex(digest.digest());
}
String startRequestSha256(Map<String, Object> originalBody) {
    requireClosedStartWireBeforeSchema(originalBody);
    var overrides = originalBody.containsKey("agentTaskOverrides")
        ? requireObject(originalBody.get("agentTaskOverrides")) : Map.of();
    var variables = requireObject(originalBody.get("variables"));
    validateTypedIntegerLeaves(variables);
    validateTypedIntegerLeaves(overrides);
    return sha256("AUTOMATION_START_REQUEST_V2", utf8(requiredString(originalBody, "definitionKey")),
        utf8(requiredString(originalBody, "businessKey")), utf8(requiredString(originalBody, "correlationId")),
        canonicalBytes(variables), canonicalBytes(overrides));
}
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
@Data @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor @Accessors(chain = true) @Builder
class AutomationWorkerTaskDTO {
    @NotBlank @Size(max = 255) private String taskId;
    @NotBlank @Size(max = 255) private String activityOccurrenceId;
    @NotBlank @Size(max = 128) private String nodeExecutionRef;
    @NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}") private String leaseToken;
    @NotBlank @Size(max = 128) private String capabilityKey;
    @Min(1) @Max(999999999999999L) private long capabilityVersion;
    @NotNull @Valid private Map<String, Object> input;
    @NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "[0-9a-f]{64}") private String inputSha256;
    @NotBlank @Size(max = 128) private String effectKey;
    @NotNull private Instant attemptDeadlineAt;
    @NotNull private Instant leaseExpiresAt;
    @NotBlank @Size(max = 128) private String handlerVersion;
    @NotNull private WorkerEffectSafetyEnum effectMode;
    private String targetId;
    @NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "[0-9a-f]{64}") private String inputSchemaSha256;
    @NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "[0-9a-f]{64}") private String outputSchemaSha256;
    @NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "[0-9a-f]{64}") private String effectFingerprint;
    @Valid private WorkerEffectRecoveryVO effectRecovery;
    @NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "[0-9a-f]{64}") private String taskContractSha256;
    void verifyContractHash(long trustedTenantId, String trustedSourceId) {
        var leaseSha = leaseTokenSha256(leaseToken);
        var envelope = taskFieldsWithoutContractHashAndWithLeaseDigest(leaseSha);
        var digest = sha256("AUTOMATION_WORKER_TASK_V2",
            utf8(Long.toString(trustedTenantId)), utf8(trustedSourceId), canonicalBytes(envelope));
        requireHashMatch(taskContractSha256, digest);
    }
    private String leaseTokenSha256(String token) {
        requireUnpadded43CharacterBase64Url(token);
        var bytes = Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(token);
        require32BytesAndCanonicalBase64UrlRoundTrip(bytes, token);
        return lowerHex(sha256Digest().digest(bytes));
    }
}
```

```java
@Data @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor @Accessors(chain = true) @Builder
class AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand {
    @NotBlank @Size(max = 128) private String templateKey;
    @Min(1) @Max(999999999999999L) private long templateVersion;
    @NotNull private RuntimeprofileEnum runtimeProfile;
    @NotBlank @Size(max = 128) private String executorRef;
    @NotNull @Valid private ProcessSchemaVO inputSchema;
    @NotNull @Valid private ProcessSchemaVO outputSchema;
    @NotNull @Valid private ProcessSchemaVO parameterSchema;
    @NotNull @Valid private TemplateConfigurationVO configuration;
    @NotNull @Valid private TechnicalLimitsVO limits;
    // 严格构造/解码按本文件Contract/signature与Error/edge项复核交叉字段。
    public record TemplateConfigurationVO(@NotNull @Valid TemplateDependencyRefVO instructionRef,
            @NotBlank String modelRef, @NotNull @Size(max = 32) List<@NotNull @Valid TemplateDependencyRefVO> toolRefs,
            @com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude(com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL)
            @Valid AgenticTemplatePlanVO agenticPlan) {
        public TemplateConfigurationVO { requireExactModelRef(modelRef); toolRefs = List.copyOf(toolRefs); }
        static TemplateConfigurationVO fromExactWire(Map<String, Object> source) {
            requireAllowedFieldsAndNonNullUnless(source, CONFIGURATION_FIELDS, Set.of());
            var plan = source.containsKey("agenticPlan") ? AgenticTemplatePlanVO.fromExactWire(requiredObject(source, "agenticPlan")) : null;
            return new TemplateConfigurationVO(readInstructionRef(source), readModelRef(source), readRequiredToolRefs(source), plan);
        }
    }
    public record TemplateDependencyRefVO(String key, @Min(1) @Max(999999999999999L) long version, String contentSha256) {
        public TemplateDependencyRefVO {
            requireExactResourceKeyWithoutTrimming(key);
            requireBoundedVersion(version);
            requireLowercaseSha256(contentSha256);
        }
    }
    public record AgenticTemplateLeafVO(String agentKey, @Valid TemplateDependencyRefVO instructionRef, String modelRef,
            List<@NotNull @Valid TemplateDependencyRefVO> toolRefs) {
        public AgenticTemplateLeafVO { requireExactPathSegment(agentKey, "[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}");
            requireLeafIdentityAndReferences(); toolRefs = List.copyOf(toolRefs); }
    }
    public record AgenticTemplatePlanVO(AgenticStrategyEnum strategy, List<AgenticTemplateLeafVO> agents,
            List<AgenticTemplateLinkVO> links, Integer maxRounds, int maxParallelism,
            String outputAgentKey, AgenticMergeEnum merge, List<String> sharedFields,
            AgenticTemplateTerminationVO termination) {
        public AgenticTemplatePlanVO {
            agents = List.copyOf(agents);
            links = List.copyOf(links);
            sharedFields = List.copyOf(sharedFields);
            requireUniqueLeavesAndBoundedStrategy(strategy, agents, maxRounds, maxParallelism);
            requireDeclaredDistinctHandoffLinks(strategy, agents, links);
            requireMergeAndOutputKey(strategy, merge, outputAgentKey, agents);
            requireBoundedSharedPathsAndTermination(strategy, agents, sharedFields, termination);
        }
        static AgenticTemplatePlanVO fromExactWire(Map<String, Object> source) {
            requireAllowedFieldsAndNonNullUnless(source, PLAN_FIELDS, Set.of("maxRounds", "outputAgentKey"));
            return new AgenticTemplatePlanVO(readStrategyOr(source, REASONING), readRequiredLeaves(source),
                readLinksOrEmpty(source), readNullableRounds(source), readParallelismOr(source, 1),
                readNullableOutputKey(source), readMergeOr(source, OUTPUT_AGENT), readSharedFieldsOrEmpty(source),
                readTerminationOr(source, new AgenticRootTerminalVO(ROOT_TERMINAL)));
        }
    }
    public record AgenticTemplateLinkVO(String source, String target) {
        public AgenticTemplateLinkVO { requireDifferentExactAgentKeys(source, target); }
    }
    public sealed interface AgenticTemplateTerminationVO permits AgenticRootTerminalVO, AgenticPredicateVO {}
    public record AgenticRootTerminalVO(AgenticTerminationModeEnum mode) implements AgenticTemplateTerminationVO {
        public AgenticRootTerminalVO { requireMode(mode, ROOT_TERMINAL); }
    }
    public record AgenticPredicateVO(AgenticTerminationModeEnum mode, AgenticConditionVO condition)
            implements AgenticTemplateTerminationVO {
        public AgenticPredicateVO { requireMode(mode, PREDICATE); requireClosedBoundedCondition(condition); }
    }
    public sealed interface AgenticConditionVO permits AgenticConditionOperationVO, AgenticConditionPathVO, AgenticConditionLiteralVO {}
    public record AgenticConditionOperationVO(AgenticConditionOpEnum op, List<AgenticConditionVO> args)
            implements AgenticConditionVO {
        public AgenticConditionOperationVO { args = List.copyOf(args); requireOperatorArity(op, args.size()); }
    }
    public record AgenticConditionPathVO(String path) implements AgenticConditionVO {
        public AgenticConditionPathVO { requireFixedInputOutputOrRoundPath(path); }
    }
    public record AgenticConditionLiteralVO(Object literal) implements AgenticConditionVO {
        public AgenticConditionLiteralVO { literal = copyBoundedTypedLiteralAllowingNull(literal); }
    }
    public enum AgenticStrategyEnum {
        REASONING, SEQUENTIAL, PARALLEL, BOUNDED_LOOP, HANDOFF;
        @JsonValue public String wire() { return name(); }
    }
    public enum AgenticMergeEnum {
        OUTPUT_AGENT, COLLECT_BY_AGENT;
        @JsonValue public String wire() { return name(); }
    }
    public enum AgenticTerminationModeEnum {
        ROOT_TERMINAL, PREDICATE;
        @JsonValue public String wire() { return name(); }
    }
    public enum AgenticConditionOpEnum {
        EQ, NE, GT, GE, LT, LE, AND, OR, NOT;
        @JsonValue public String wire() { return name(); }
    }
    record TechnicalLimitsVO(Duration totalTimeout, Duration modelIdleTimeout, Duration toolTimeout, int maxModelCalls, int maxToolCalls, int maxParallelism, int contextWindowTokens, int maxOutputTokensPerCall) {}
    enum RuntimeprofileEnum { RUNTIME_V2; @JsonValue String wire() { return name(); } }
}
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
record AgentTerminalEventV2(int schemaVersion, String producerId, String eventId, long tenantId,
    String ownerIssuerSha256, String ownerSubjectId, String idempotencyKey, AgentProcessLink link,
    String definitionKey, @Min(1) @Max(999999999999999L) long definitionVersion,
    String runId, @Min(1) @Max(999999999999999L) long terminalRevision, String nodeExecutionRef,
    String configurationSha256, String inputSha256, String outputSchemaSha256, AgentRunStatusEnum status,
    Instant finishedAt, String resultSha256, Map<String, Object> output, AgentResultArtifactRefVO artifactRef,
    String errorCode, SideEffectOutcomeEnum sideEffectOutcome) {
    AgentTerminalEventV2 { requireTerminalStatusAndShape(); requireBoundedVersions(definitionVersion, terminalRevision);
        output = deepCopyIfPresent(output); validateTypedIntegerLeaves(output);
        requireMaxCanonicalInlineBytes(8192); verifyV2Identity(); verifyV2ResultHash(); }
    String fingerprint() { return ProcessTypedJson.sha256("tianji-agent-terminal-event-v2", canonicalEnvelope()); }
    enum SideEffectOutcomeEnum { NONE, CONFIRMED, UNKNOWN; @JsonValue String wire() { return name(); } }
}
```

- Purpose: 声明中立闭合值及入口不变量。
- Symbols: `AgenticPlanVO`；AgenticPlanVO。

- Contract/signature changes: AgenticPlanVO。
- Input/output and state mapping: strategy,agents,links,maxRounds,maxParallelism,outputAgentKey,merge,sharedFields,termination九个有效字段；各策略组合、精确叶子引用和两种终止tag遵循Spec§10.3；组件不依赖C。
- Error and edge behavior: 1–16独立leaf；loop/handoff≤32；图内仅声明的key。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001, MC-NAME-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-MODEL-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-TIME-001。维持现有边界、技术JDBC/Outbox及原应用历史；使用有语义的Java载体名；边界以@Valid/@Validated及闭合规则验证，并使用可信宿主/当前权限；不可变值用record紧凑构造、防御复制；Spring Jackson边界与固定code，禁止ordinal；用Instant/Duration和DB微秒时钟，不延长原截止。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 11, Rule 1, Rule 2, Rule 3, Rule 6, Rule 10。AgenticPlanVO；strategy,agents,links,maxRounds,maxParallelism,outputAgentKey,merge,sharedFields,termination九个有效字段；各策略组合、精确叶子引用和两种终止tag遵循Spec§10.3；组件不依赖C。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
public record AgenticPlanVO(StrategyEnum strategy, List<LeafVO> agents, List<LinkVO> links,
        Integer maxRounds, int maxParallelism, String outputAgentKey, MergeEnum merge,
        List<String> sharedFields, TerminationVO termination) {
    public AgenticPlanVO {
        agents = List.copyOf(agents); links = List.copyOf(links); sharedFields = List.copyOf(sharedFields);
        requireExactStrategyBoundsAndUniqueAgentKeys();
        requireOnlyDeclaredHandoffLinksAndApplicableRoundCount();
        requireOutputKeyAndMergeCompatibility();
        requireFixedInputOrCompletedOutputPathsAndBoundedCondition();
    }
    public record DependencyRefVO(String key, long version, String contentSha256) {
        public DependencyRefVO { requireExactKeyVersionAndSha256(key, version, contentSha256); }
    }
    public record LeafVO(String agentKey, DependencyRefVO instructionRef, String modelRef, List<DependencyRefVO> toolRefs) {
        public LeafVO { requirePathSegment(agentKey, "[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}");
            Objects.requireNonNull(instructionRef); requireExactModelRef(modelRef); toolRefs = List.copyOf(toolRefs); requireAtMost32Tools(toolRefs); }
    }
    public record LinkVO(String source, String target) { public LinkVO { requireDifferentDeclaredKeys(source, target); } }
    public enum StrategyEnum { REASONING, SEQUENTIAL, PARALLEL, BOUNDED_LOOP, HANDOFF }
    public enum MergeEnum { OUTPUT_AGENT, COLLECT_BY_AGENT }
    public enum TerminationModeEnum { ROOT_TERMINAL, PREDICATE }
    public enum ConditionOpEnum { EQ, NE, GT, GE, LT, LE, AND, OR, NOT }
    public sealed interface TerminationVO permits RootTerminalVO, PredicateVO {}
    public record RootTerminalVO(TerminationModeEnum mode) implements TerminationVO {
        public RootTerminalVO { if (mode != TerminationModeEnum.ROOT_TERMINAL) throw invalidAgenticPlan(); }
    }
    public record PredicateVO(TerminationModeEnum mode, ConditionVO condition) implements TerminationVO {
        public PredicateVO { if (mode != TerminationModeEnum.PREDICATE) throw invalidAgenticPlan();
            requireClosedConditionWithin64NodesAndDepth8(Objects.requireNonNull(condition)); }
    }
    public sealed interface ConditionVO permits OperationVO, PathVO, LiteralVO {}
    public record OperationVO(ConditionOpEnum op, List<ConditionVO> args) implements ConditionVO {
        public OperationVO { args = List.copyOf(args); requireOperatorArityAndBounds(op, args); }
    }
    public record PathVO(String path) implements ConditionVO { public PathVO { requireAllowedFixedPathOrRound(path); } }
    public record LiteralVO(Object literal) implements ConditionVO {
        public LiteralVO { literal = copyBoundedTypedValueAllowNull(literal); }
    }
    // 所有构造不变量与Spec九字段/两个tag分支一致；内部值已有效，缺省处理只在宿主wire解析边界。
}
```

#### File 7 — `CREATE stellar-enclosure-component-agent-flow-starter/src/main/java/top/egon/cola/component/agentflow/agentic/AgenticPlanCompiler.java`

- Purpose: 复用策略接缝并按leaf独立装配。
- Symbols: `AgenticPlanCompiler`；AgenticPlanCompiler。
- Repository evidence: 现有workflow三策略与AgentFlowFactory。
- Dependencies and consumers: ADK adapter。
- Why now: 该测试已定义目标，添加本步最小可编译依赖。
- Contract/signature changes: AgenticPlanCompiler。
- Input/output and state mapping: REASONING/SEQUENTIAL/PARALLEL/BOUNDED_LOOP/HANDOFF；limits取交集。
- Error and edge behavior: 拒绝无界控制或未声明共享数据。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-LOG-001, MC-BEAN-001, MC-PATTERN-001。维持现有边界、技术JDBC/Outbox及原应用历史；边界以@Valid/@Validated及闭合规则验证，并使用可信宿主/当前权限；具名Bean agenticPlanCompiler；业务类@Slf4j，依赖final并用@RequiredArgsConstructor(onConstructor_=@Autowired)及Qualifier传播；沿既有Strategy/Adapter、按固定版本派发。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 11, Rule 2, Rule 4, Rule 9。AgenticPlanCompiler；REASONING/SEQUENTIAL/PARALLEL/BOUNDED_LOOP/HANDOFF；limits取交集。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
var strategy = resolveDeclaredStrategy(plan.strategy());
var leaves = compileIndependentRegisteredLeaves(plan.agents(), fixedContext);
var bounded = strategy.compile(leaves, minParallelism(plan, limits), plan.maxRounds());
if (plan.strategy() != BOUNDED_LOOP && plan.strategy() != HANDOFF) {
    var completed = bounded.awaitAllRequiredLeavesAndTrustedRootTerminal(fixedContext);
    return validateFrozenOutputSchema(mergeAllRequiredCompletedLeaves(plan, completed));
}
for (var completed : bounded.completedRoundOrLeafEvents()) {
    revalidateOriginalNodeDeadlineCancelAndCurrentPermit(fixedContext);
    var visible = authorizedCompletedValuesOnly(plan.sharedFields(), completed, fixedContext);
    if (satisfiesDeclaredTermination(plan.termination(), completed.trustedRootTerminal(), visible)) {
        return validateFrozenOutputSchema(mergeCompletedResults(plan.merge(), plan.outputAgentKey(), plan.agents()));
    }
    if (completed.roundOrTransferCount() >= requiredMaxRounds(plan)) return failed("AGENTIC_LIMIT_EXCEEDED");
    if (plan.strategy() == HANDOFF) {
        var next = requireTrustedTypedTransferAlongDeclaredEdge(completed, plan.links());
        if (next == null) return failed("INVALID_OUTPUT");
        bounded.dispatchAfterFreshPermit(next);
    }
}
// 有界策略没有可确认终态却结束事件流，不能把最后一个leaf当成功。
return failed("INVALID_OUTPUT");
```

```java
return cancelAndCloseOnRootTerminal(runner);
```

- Purpose: 内存实现原生Memory的精确状态和重放。

- Error and edge behavior: VERSION_CONFLICT、COMMAND_CONFLICT、EXPIRED，已删无命中。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-MODEL-001, MC-LOG-001, MC-BEAN-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-PATTERN-001, MC-TIME-001。维持现有边界、技术JDBC/Outbox及原应用历史；边界以@Valid/@Validated及闭合规则验证，并使用可信宿主/当前权限；行为类和接口不套用POJO模型注解；具名Bean inMemoryMemoryStore；业务类@Slf4j，依赖final并用@RequiredArgsConstructor(onConstructor_=@Autowired)及Qualifier传播；Spring Jackson边界与固定code，禁止ordinal；沿既有Strategy/Adapter、按固定版本派发；用Instant/Duration和DB微秒时钟，不延长原截止。

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
var prior = slots.computeIfAbsent(scope.hash(), key -> new ScopeSlot(scope));
synchronized (prior) {
  permit.revalidate(scope);
  var receipt = prior.findReceipt("NATIVE", command.commandId());
  return receipt == null ? applyExpectedRevisionAndWriteReceipt(prior, command)
                         : replayMatchingNativeDigest(receipt, command);
}
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE tianji_process_automation_release (
    tenant_id bigint NOT NULL,
    release_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    root_definition_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    source_descriptor jsonb NOT NULL,
    source_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    compiler_version varchar(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    compiled_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    source_draft_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    source_draft_revision bigint NOT NULL,
    draft_content_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    dependency_manifest jsonb NOT NULL,
    dependency_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,release_key),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(source_descriptor) = 'object')
);

CREATE TABLE tianji_process_draft (
    tenant_id bigint NOT NULL,
    draft_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    definition_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    title varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    owner_type varchar(16) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    owner_issuer char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    owner_id varchar(256) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    base_release_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    base_source_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C",
    state varchar(16) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    revision bigint NOT NULL,
    content_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    published_release_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    published_revision bigint,
    publish_command_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    published_at timestamptz(6),
    last_command_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,draft_id),
    CHECK (state IN ('EDITING','PUBLISHED','DISCARDED')),
    CHECK (revision > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE tianji_process_draft_command (
    tenant_id bigint NOT NULL,
    actor_type varchar(16) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    actor_issuer char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    actor_id varchar(256) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    command_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    operation varchar(16) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    draft_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    request_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    result_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    completed_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,actor_type,actor_issuer,actor_id,command_id),
    CHECK (operation IN ('CREATE','SAVE','DISCARD','PUBLISH'))
);

CREATE TABLE tianji_process_automation_activation (
    tenant_id bigint NOT NULL,
    definition_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    revision bigint NOT NULL,
    release_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    previous_revision bigint,
    actor_type varchar(16) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    actor_issuer char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    actor_id varchar(256) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    command_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    request_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    source_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    compiled_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    dependency_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    authorization_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    dependency_evidence_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    release_signature_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    trust_generation bigint NOT NULL,
    admission_proof jsonb NOT NULL,
    observed_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    proof_valid_until timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    activated_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,definition_key,revision),
    CHECK ((revision=1 AND previous_revision IS NULL) OR (revision>1 AND previous_revision=revision-1))
);

CREATE TABLE tianji_process_instance_binding (
    tenant_id bigint NOT NULL,
    instance_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    release_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    definition_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    owner_type varchar(16) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    owner_issuer varchar(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    owner_id varchar(256) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    profile varchar(16) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb NOT NULL,
    configuration_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    start_request_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    activation_revision bigint NOT NULL,
    source_command_type varchar(32) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    source_command_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    resolved_start_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    admission_kind varchar(8) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    source_event_receipt_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    admission_evidence jsonb NOT NULL,
    admitted_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,instance_id),
    CHECK (activation_revision > 0),
    CHECK (source_command_type = 'START'),
    CHECK ((admission_kind = 'DIRECT' AND source_event_receipt_id IS NULL) OR (admission_kind = 'EVENT' AND source_event_receipt_id IS NOT NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE tianji_process_node_execution (
    tenant_id bigint NOT NULL,
    instance_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    occurrence_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    attempt integer NOT NULL,
    node_execution_ref varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    node_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    kind varchar(32) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    parent_scope_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    attempt_scope_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    branch_index integer,
    iteration_index integer,
    excluded boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    native_job_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C",
    native_subscription_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C",
    capability_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    capability_version bigint,
    effect_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    input_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    input_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    input_schema_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    output_schema_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    configuration_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    state varchar(32) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    revision bigint NOT NULL,
    output_json jsonb,
    output_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C",
    agent_run_id varchar(64) COLLATE "C",
    side_effect_outcome varchar(16) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    error_code varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    started_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    node_deadline_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    attempt_deadline_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    accepted_at timestamptz,
    finished_at timestamptz,
    retry_command_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    retry_request_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C",
    worker_effect_recovery jsonb,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,instance_id,occurrence_id,attempt),
    CHECK (attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 10),
    CONSTRAINT node_execution_recovery_check CHECK (worker_effect_recovery IS NULL OR (attempt >= 2 AND effect_key IS NOT NULL AND retry_command_id IS NOT NULL AND retry_request_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND kind IN ('SERVICE','RULE') AND jsonb_typeof(worker_effect_recovery) = 'object' AND octet_length(worker_effect_recovery::text) <= 4096 AND worker_effect_recovery ?& ARRAY['mode','observedGeneration','observedAt','validUntil','authorityRef','evidenceSha256','businessReceiptId','resultSha256'] AND worker_effect_recovery - ARRAY['mode','observedGeneration','observedAt','validUntil','authorityRef','evidenceSha256','businessReceiptId','resultSha256'] = '{}'::jsonb AND worker_effect_recovery->>'mode' IN ('REPLAY_APPLIED','RETRY_NOT_APPLIED') AND ((worker_effect_recovery->>'mode' = 'REPLAY_APPLIED' AND worker_effect_recovery->>'businessReceiptId' IS NOT NULL AND worker_effect_recovery->>'resultSha256' IS NOT NULL) OR (worker_effect_recovery->>'mode' = 'RETRY_NOT_APPLIED' AND worker_effect_recovery->'businessReceiptId' = 'null'::jsonb AND worker_effect_recovery->'resultSha256' = 'null'::jsonb))))
);
```

```java
record WorkerEffectEvidenceVO(Status status,String effectKey,String effectFingerprint,String targetId,long dispatchGeneration,String authorityRef,Instant observedAt,Instant validUntil,String evidenceSha256,String businessReceiptId,Map<String,Object> output,String resultSha256) {
    WorkerEffectEvidenceVO {
        requireIdentity(effectKey,effectFingerprint,targetId,dispatchGeneration);
        requireResultGroup(status,businessReceiptId,output,resultSha256);
        if(status==APPLIED) requireEqual(resultSha256,ProcessTypedJson.sha256("AUTOMATION_WORKER_RESULT_V2",utf8(effectFingerprint),utf8(businessReceiptId),ProcessTypedJson.canonicalBytes(output)));
        output=immutableDeepCopy(output);
    }
}
```

```java
record AutomationWorkerExecutionContextVO(String sourceId,long tenantId,String effectKey,Map<String,Object> input,Instant deadlineAt){
    static AutomationWorkerExecutionContextVO from(AutomationWorkerTaskDTO task,WorkerHost host,Instant dbNow){
        Instant due=min(task.getLeaseExpiresAt(),task.getAttemptDeadlineAt(),proofDeadline(task)).minus(host.deadlineSafetyMargin());
        requireBefore(dbNow,due);
        return new AutomationWorkerExecutionContextVO(host.sourceId(),host.tenantId(),task.getEffectKey(),immutableDeepCopy(task.getInput()),due);
    }
}
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE tianji_worker_effect_receipt (
    source_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    tenant_id bigint NOT NULL,
    effect_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    capability_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    capability_version bigint NOT NULL,
    input_schema_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    business_input_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    state varchar(16) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    result_json jsonb,
    business_receipt_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C",
    revision bigint NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,

    handler_version varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    target_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    effect_fingerprint char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    result_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C",
    dispatch_generation bigint NOT NULL,
    last_reconciliation jsonb,
    reconciled_at timestamptz(6),
    PRIMARY KEY (source_id,tenant_id,effect_key),
    CHECK (dispatch_generation >= 1 AND revision >= 1),
    CHECK ((state = 'COMPLETED') = (result_json IS NOT NULL AND result_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND business_receipt_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((target_id IS NULL) = (effect_mode = 'TRANSACTIONAL_RECEIPT'))
);

```

```java
String automationEffectFingerprint(AutomationWorkerHandlerDescriptor d,Map<String,Object> input){
    return lengthPrefixedSha256(AUTOMATION_EFFECT_DOMAIN,d.capabilityKey(),d.capabilityVersion(),d.inputSchemaSha256(),d.outputSchemaSha256(),d.effectMode(),d.handlerVersion(),d.targetId(),canonicalTypedJson(input));
}
String automationResultSha256(String fingerprint,AutomationWorkerBusinessResultDTO result){
    requireNonblank(result.getBusinessReceiptId());
    return ProcessTypedJson.sha256("AUTOMATION_WORKER_RESULT_V2",utf8(fingerprint),utf8(result.getBusinessReceiptId()),ProcessTypedJson.canonicalBytes(requireNonNull(result.getOutput())));
}
String canonicalLeaseTokenSha256(String token){
    byte[] decoded=Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(require43Base64UrlChars(token));
    require(decoded.length==32&&Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(decoded).equals(token));
    return sha256Hex(decoded);
}
```

- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-NAME-001, MC-MODEL-001, MC-BEAN-001。Rule 2 @Validated及参数@Valid，DTO先校验再调用；Rule 4 @Slf4j、命名Bean `workerEffectReceiptStore`，最终依赖字段@Qualifier并以@RequiredArgsConstructor(onConstructor_ = @Autowired)注入；Rule 9 复用现有Strategy/Adapter；Rule 10 以Instant/DB时钟比较；Rule 11 现有API→服务→技术Store。

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
AutomationWorkerBusinessResultDTO executeTransactional(AutomationWorkerTaskDTO task,AutomationWorkerHandlerRegistration registration){
    return transaction.execute(tx->{
        lockEffect(sourceId,tenantId,task.getEffectKey());
        EffectRow row=findExact(task.getEffectKey());
        if(isCompletedMatching(row,task)) return replay(row);
        requireBefore(databaseNow(),deadline(task));
        var result=validateResult(registration.transactional().execute(context(task),jdbc),task);
        requireBefore(databaseNow(),deadline(task));
        completeEffect(row,result.getBusinessReceiptId(),result.getOutput(),automationResultSha256(task.getEffectFingerprint(),result));
        return result;
    });
}
ExternalAction resolveExternal(AutomationWorkerTaskDTO task){
    EffectRow observed=readOutsideTransaction(task);
    var evidence=resolver.resolve(query(task,observed));
    return transaction.execute(tx->{
        lockEffect(sourceId,tenantId,task.getEffectKey());
        EffectRow current=findExact(task.getEffectKey());
        verifyEvidenceAndDeadline(current,evidence,task);
        if(evidence.status()==APPLIED) {
            requireEqual(evidence.resultSha256(),ProcessTypedJson.sha256("AUTOMATION_WORKER_RESULT_V2",utf8(current.effectFingerprint()),utf8(evidence.businessReceiptId()),ProcessTypedJson.canonicalBytes(evidence.output())));
            return completeAndReplay(current,evidence.businessReceiptId(),evidence.output(),evidence.resultSha256());
        } return eligibleFrozenGeneration(task,current,evidence) ? claimOnce(current.revision(),current.generation()) : noDispatch();
    });
}
boolean eligibleFrozenGeneration(AutomationWorkerTaskDTO task,EffectRow current,WorkerEffectEvidenceVO evidence,Instant dbNow){
    var recovery=task.getEffectRecovery();
    if(recovery==null||recovery.mode()!=RETRY_NOT_APPLIED) return false;
    return evidence.status()==NOT_APPLIED_FINAL&&current.generation()==recovery.observedGeneration()&&evidence.dispatchGeneration()==current.generation()&&dbNow.isBefore(recovery.validUntil())&&dbNow.isBefore(evidence.validUntil());
}
```

```java
static WorkerExecutionReceipt fromAutomation(String effectFingerprint,AutomationWorkerBusinessResultDTO result,String resultSha256){
    requireNonNullBusinessOutput(result.getOutput());
    requireEqual(resultSha256,ProcessTypedJson.sha256("AUTOMATION_WORKER_RESULT_V2",utf8(effectFingerprint),utf8(result.getBusinessReceiptId()),ProcessTypedJson.canonicalBytes(result.getOutput())));
    return receiptWithTypedResult(result.getBusinessReceiptId(),immutableDeepCopy(result.getOutput()),resultSha256);
}
```

```java
}
```

#### File 3 — `CREATE stellar-enclosure-tianji-client/src/main/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianji/client/AutomationHttpTransport.java`

- Purpose: 共享新v2 Process SDK的有界HTTP骨架。
- Symbols: `AutomationHttpTransport`
- Repository evidence: 复用HttpProcessClient、HttpLinkedAgentClient固定URI、Strict Jackson和有界响应惯例；C接口已冻结。
- Dependencies and consumers: HttpProcessDraftClient、HttpProcessActivationClient、HttpProcessAutomationClient、HttpProcessEventClient及HttpAutomationWorkerClient

- Input/output and state mapping: 仅白名单路径段和参数经UTF-8编码；禁redirect、禁跨origin；Content-Type JSON，No body GET；每个操作显式status/字节限制，无自动写重试。
- Error and edge behavior: 超时、截断、意外状态、超界响应、非JSON与认证错误保留稳定码，不能回退旧路由或自动换原命令键。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-TIME-001, MC-LOG-001
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 2、Rule 5、Rule 6、Rule 9、Rule 10、Rule 11：显式操作adapter、界限/UTC/错误，不记录凭据或正文；手动构造SDK不作Spring Bean。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
Response send(Operation op, String path, Map<String,String> query, Object body) {
    long started = calls.begin();
    String token = calls.token(tokenSupplier, started);
    HttpRequest request = buildBoundedRequest(op, checkedSameOriginPath(path), query, body, token);
    var pending = calls.track(http.sendAsync(request, info -> new BoundedBodySubscriber(op.responseLimit())));
    try { return requireExactStatusAndContentType(pending.get(calls.remaining(started), NANOSECONDS), op); }
    catch (TimeoutException failure) { pending.cancel(true); throw unavailable(); }
    finally { calls.untrack(pending); }
}
```

- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-TIME-001, MC-LOG-001
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 2、Rule 5、Rule 6、Rule 9、Rule 10、Rule 11：显式操作adapter、界限/UTC/错误，不记录凭据或正文；手动构造SDK不作Spring Bean。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
<T> T decode(byte[] bytes, ClosedOperation<T> operation) {
    JsonNode root = strictJackson.readTree(bytes);
    operation.requireClosedFieldsAndNullableBranches(root);
    operation.requireIntegralTokensAndExactRangesBeforeLongConversion(root);
    return operation.decodeTyped(root);
}
```

```java
DraftMutationResultDTO save(ProcessActor actor,String draftId,@Valid SaveProcessDraftCommand command){

        drafts.lockOwned(actor,draftId);
        return saveExpectedRevisionAndWriteReceipt(actor,draftId,command);
    });
}
```

```java
final class AutomationOperationException extends RuntimeException {
    private final Code code;
    AutomationOperationException(Code code){
        super(code.name());
        this.code=Objects.requireNonNull(code);
    } String stableCode(){
        return code.name();
    } enum Code {
        TIANJI_DRAFT_VERSION_CONFLICT, TIANJI_DRAFT_STATE_CONFLICT, TIANJI_DRAFT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, TIANJI_PROCESS_NOT_ACTIVATED, TIANJI_PROCESS_ACTIVATION_CONFLICT, TIANJI_EVENT_ROUTE_VERSION_CONFLICT, TIANJI_NODE_RETRY_BLOCKED, TIANJI_EVENT_CONFLICT, TIANJI_EVENT_ROUTE_CHANGED
    }
}
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
HttpInputMessage beforeBodyRead(HttpInputMessage in,MethodParameter parameter,Type type,Class<? extends HttpMessageConverter<?>> c){
    int max=boundedSizeForExactStepCommand(type);
    if(in.getHeaders().getContentLength()>max) throw new TooLarge();
    byte[] bytes=in.getBody().readNBytes(max+1);
    if(bytes.length>max) throw new TooLarge();
    validateClosedStepJson(type,strictJackson.readTree(bytes));
    return replayableInput(in,bytes);
}
```

```java
DraftPublicationVO publish(ProcessActor actor,@Valid PublishProcessDraftCommand command){
    var replay=findCommittedOriginal(actor,command);

    return transaction.execute(tx->lockRecheckDeploySealAndRecord(actor,command,compiled));
}
```

```java
HttpInputMessage beforeBodyRead(HttpInputMessage in,MethodParameter parameter,Type type,Class<? extends HttpMessageConverter<?>> c){
    int max=boundedSizeForExactStepCommand(type);
    if(in.getHeaders().getContentLength()>max) throw new TooLarge();
    byte[] bytes=in.getBody().readNBytes(max+1);
    if(bytes.length>max) throw new TooLarge();
    validateClosedStepJson(type,strictJackson.readTree(bytes));
    return replayableInput(in,bytes);
}
```

#### File 11 — `CREATE stellar-enclosure-tianji-agent-runtime/src/main/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianji/agent/application/run/AgenticTemplateConverter.java`

- Purpose: 将C的已验证闭合Agentic传输值单向转换为AF中立执行值，保持模块单向依赖。
- Symbols: `AgenticTemplateConverter.toTarget`及叶子/引用/边/终止/条件的具名映射方法；Bean `agenticTemplateConverter`。
- Repository evidence: AR同时消费C与AF，C无Spring/AF依赖，AF公共API无Tianji类型；现有Egon `BaseForwardConverter.toTarget` 和本步MapStruct处理器已明确。

- Why now: File 1先断言实际生成Bean、九字段/顺序/null和无跨模块类型，再在运行适配器之前接通转换。
- Contract/signature changes: AR内新Mapper实现BaseForwardConverter；仅转换有效plan，不接受原始HTTP Map、不做权限授权、不改变C或AF公开wire字段。
- Input/output and state mapping: strategy/agents/links/maxRounds/maxParallelism/outputAgentKey/merge/sharedFields/termination逐项映射；所有enum按固定同名码穷举。叶子引用保持key/version/hash，AST三tag和null literal保持，目标compact constructor防御复制。
- Error and edge behavior: 未知或未验证类型不得映射；拒绝漏字段、错误tag、大小/组合违规。共享来源仍在实际运行时按host当前许可复验；mapper不能复制token、租户DTO或给来源自动授权。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001/REUSE-001/VALID-001/MODEL-001/CONVERT-001/BEAN-001/JSON-001/SCOPE-001/TEST-001；MapStruct生成真实单向映射，unmappedTargetPolicy=ERROR，无JSON roundtrip。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 1 具名Converter；Rule 2 仅接已验证输入且目标构造校验；Rule 3 Egon BaseForwardConverter；Rule 4 生成类由AnnotateWith显式具名Component，按Qualifier注入；Rule 6 enum/tag不降级；Rule 11 C与AF互不依赖。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
@AnnotateWith(value = org.springframework.stereotype.Component.class,
    elements = @AnnotateWith.Element(strings = "agenticTemplateConverter"))
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring", unmappedTargetPolicy = ReportingPolicy.ERROR)
interface AgenticTemplateConverter extends BaseForwardConverter<AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticTemplatePlanVO, AgenticPlanVO> {
    @Override AgenticPlanVO toTarget(AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticTemplatePlanVO source);
    AgenticPlanVO.LeafVO toLeaf(AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticTemplateLeafVO source);
    AgenticPlanVO.DependencyRefVO toReference(AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.TemplateDependencyRefVO source);
    AgenticPlanVO.LinkVO toLink(AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticTemplateLinkVO source);
    AgenticPlanVO.RootTerminalVO toRoot(AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticRootTerminalVO source);
    AgenticPlanVO.PredicateVO toPredicate(AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticPredicateVO source);
    AgenticPlanVO.OperationVO toOperation(AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticConditionOperationVO source);
    AgenticPlanVO.PathVO toPath(AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticConditionPathVO source);
    AgenticPlanVO.LiteralVO toLiteral(AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticConditionLiteralVO source);
    default AgenticPlanVO.TerminationVO toTermination(AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticTemplateTerminationVO source) {
        return switch (source) {
            case AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticRootTerminalVO root -> toRoot(root);
            case AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticPredicateVO predicate -> toPredicate(predicate);
        };
    }
    default AgenticPlanVO.ConditionVO toCondition(AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticConditionVO source) {
        return switch (source) {
            case AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticConditionOperationVO operation -> toOperation(operation);
            case AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticConditionPathVO path -> toPath(path);
            case AgentRuntimeTemplateCommand.AgenticConditionLiteralVO literal -> toLiteral(literal);
        };
    }
}
```

- Verification contribution: AgentRuntimeExecutionServiceTest通过实际Spring具名Bean与MapStruct生成实现验证九字段、所有策略/tag、叶子独立引用和null literal；组件边界测试禁止导出C类型。
- After this file: AR可将已固定plan安全映射到AF；尚不派发外部调用，后续运行service执行当前许可与deadline门禁。

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
AutomationActivationDTO activate(ProcessActor actor,String definitionKey,@Valid ActivationCommand c){
    var prior=findAuthorizedReplay(actor,definitionKey,c);
    if(prior.isPresent()) return prior.get();
    var proof=observeOutsideTransaction(actor,definitionKey,c);
    return transaction.execute(tx->{
        PlatformReleaseTenantFence.acquireExclusive(jdbc,actor.tenantId());
        return recheckOriginalOrAppend(actor,definitionKey,c,proof,databaseNow());
    });
}
```

```java
HttpInputMessage beforeBodyRead(HttpInputMessage in,MethodParameter parameter,Type type,Class<? extends HttpMessageConverter<?>> c){
    int max=boundedSizeForExactStepCommand(type);
    if(in.getHeaders().getContentLength()>max) throw new TooLarge();
    byte[] bytes=in.getBody().readNBytes(max+1);
    if(bytes.length>max) throw new TooLarge();
    validateClosedStepJson(type,strictJackson.readTree(bytes));
    return replayableInput(in,bytes);
}
```

```java
Optional<StartReceiptObservation> findAppliedStart(ProcessActor actor,String commandId,String requestSha256){
    var receipt=findActorStart(actor,commandId);
    if(receipt.isEmpty()||!receipt.get().state().equals("APPLIED")) return Optional.empty();
    if(isLegacyRelease(receipt.get().releaseKey())) return matchLegacyDigest(receipt.get(),requestSha256);
    return joinExactV2Binding(actor,commandId,receipt.get().resourceId(),requestSha256,receipt.get().requestHash());
}
```

```java
AutomationInstanceDTO startAutomation(ProcessActor actor,@Valid AutomationStartCommand c){

        return replayOrStartBound(actor,c,proof);
    });
}
```

```java
HttpInputMessage beforeBodyRead(HttpInputMessage in,MethodParameter parameter,Type type,Class<? extends HttpMessageConverter<?>> c){
    int max=boundedSizeForExactStepCommand(type);
    if(in.getHeaders().getContentLength()>max) throw new TooLarge();
    byte[] bytes=in.getBody().readNBytes(max+1);
    if(bytes.length>max) throw new TooLarge();
    validateClosedStepJson(type,strictJackson.readTree(bytes));
    return replayableInput(in,bytes);
}
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
<T> T execute(CommandConfig config,Command<T> command,CommandExecutor next){
    var root=locateRootReadOnly(command);
    if(root.isEmpty()||metadataOnly(command)) return next.execute(config,command);
    bindings.lockRoot(root.get().tenantId(),root.get().instanceId());
    markCurrentProcessTransaction(root.get());
    return next.execute(config,command);
}
```

```java
        return cancelNativeAndScheduleClosures(root,command);
    });
}
```

```java
HttpInputMessage beforeBodyRead(HttpInputMessage in,MethodParameter parameter,Type type,Class<? extends HttpMessageConverter<?>> c){
    int max=boundedSizeForExactStepCommand(type);
    if(in.getHeaders().getContentLength()>max) throw new TooLarge();
    byte[] bytes=in.getBody().readNBytes(max+1);
    if(bytes.length>max) throw new TooLarge();
    validateClosedStepJson(type,strictJackson.readTree(bytes));
    return replayableInput(in,bytes);
}
```

```java
void process(RegisteredHandler handler,long generation){
    if(!active(generation)) return;
    if(handler.profile()==LEGACY_V1){
        processLegacy(handler,generation);
        return;
    } var task=typedClient.acquire(new AutomationWorkerAcquireCommand(handler.key(),handler.version())).getTask();
    if(task==null) return;
    requireTrustedHostAndDescriptor(task,handler);
    requireEqual(task.getTaskContractSha256(),canonicalTaskDigest(task,canonicalLeaseTokenSha256(task.getLeaseToken())));
    var result=store.executeAutomation(task,handler.automation());
    reportOriginalCommandWithBoundedRetry(task,result);
}
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
AutomationWorkerReportDTO completeAutomation(ProcessActor actor,@Valid AutomationWorkerCompletionCommand command){
    String tokenSha=WorkerLeaseStore.tokenHash(command.getLeaseToken());
    var replay=findAuthorizedOriginalReport(actor,command,tokenSha);
    if(replay.isPresent()) return replay.get();
    return transaction.execute(tx->{
        var lease=lockGuardNativeThenLease(actor,command,tokenSha);
        reserveReportOrReplay(actor,command,lease,tokenSha);
        var output=requireSchemaValidObject(command.getOutput(),lease);
        String nodeOutputSha=ProcessTypedJson.sha256("AUTOMATION_NODE_OUTPUT_V2",utf8(verifiedOutputSchemaSha256(lease)),ProcessTypedJson.canonicalBytes(output));
        var resultRef=nodeStore.acceptCanonicalResult(command.getNodeExecutionRef(),output,nodeOutputSha,databaseNow());
        process.getManagementService().createExternalWorkerCompletionBuilder(command.getTaskId(),nativeOwner()).variables(Map.of("resultRef",resultRef)).complete();
        return finishLeaseAndApplyReceipt(actor,command,legacyPhysicalResultDigest(resultRef));
    });
}
AutomationWorkerReportDTO failAutomation(ProcessActor actor,@Valid AutomationWorkerFailureCommand c){
    return reportInOriginalScope(actor,c,WorkerLeaseStore.tokenHash(c.getLeaseToken()),(lease,row)->{
        var triple=legacySafeFailure(c.getKind(),approvedRetry(row,c));
        nodeStore.acceptOriginalFailure(row,c.getErrorCode(),c.getKind());
        return finishFailureAndCommand(lease,triple,c);
    });
}
String taskContractSha256(AutomationWorkerTaskDTO task,FixedWorkerHostVO host){
    return ProcessTypedJson.sha256("AUTOMATION_WORKER_TASK_V2",utf8(Long.toString(host.tenantId())),utf8(host.sourceId()),ProcessTypedJson.canonicalBytes(taskFieldsWithoutOwnDigest(task,WorkerLeaseStore.tokenHash(task.getLeaseToken()))));
}
String workerReportSha256(ReportOperation operation,ProcessActor actor,WorkerReportCommandFields fields,String originalTaskContractSha256){
    String tokenSha=WorkerLeaseStore.tokenHash(fields.leaseToken());
    var canonicalReport=reportFields(operation,actor,fields.commandId(),fields.taskId(),fields.activityOccurrenceId(),fields.nodeExecutionRef(),tokenSha,originalTaskContractSha256,fields.effectKey(),fields.businessResultOrFailure());
    return ProcessTypedJson.sha256("AUTOMATION_WORKER_REPORT_V2",ProcessTypedJson.canonicalBytes(canonicalReport));
}
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
void onWorkerAttemptTimeout(DelegateExecution execution){
    requireCurrentRootGuard(execution);
    var scope=lockExactNativeAttempt(execution);
    var history=workerLeases.inspectExactAttempt(scope);
    var row=nodeStore.lockExact(scope.nodeExecutionRef());
    Instant now=databaseNow();
    if(isNativeTerminal(execution)) return;
    if(row.hasAcceptedResult()) {
        applyPreviouslyAcceptedResult(row);
        return;
    } if(row.canWrite()&&(!history.isComplete()||history.everLeased())&&!row.hasTrustedNoEffectEvidence()) {
        nodeStore.markEffectUnknown(row);
        if(now.isBefore(row.nodeDeadlineAt())) routeNativeWaitRecovery(execution);
        else applyOnNodeTimeout(execution,row);
        return;
    } requireReadOnlyOrPreventFutureClaim(scope,row,history);
    applyBoundedOnAttemptTimeoutOrNodeTimeout(execution,row,now);
}
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
HttpInputMessage beforeBodyRead(HttpInputMessage in,MethodParameter parameter,Type type,Class<? extends HttpMessageConverter<?>> c){
    int max=boundedSizeForExactStepCommand(type);
    if(in.getHeaders().getContentLength()>max) throw new TooLarge();
    byte[] bytes=in.getBody().readNBytes(max+1);
    if(bytes.length>max) throw new TooLarge();
    validateClosedStepJson(type,strictJackson.readTree(bytes));
    return replayableInput(in,bytes);
}
```

```java
record WorkerEffectRecoveryProofVO(Status status,String querySha256,String authorityRef,String effectKey,String effectFingerprint,String targetId,Long observedGeneration,Instant observedAt,Instant validUntil,String evidenceSha256,String businessReceiptId,Map<String,Object> output,String resultSha256){
    WorkerEffectRecoveryProofVO {
        requireProofShape(status,observedGeneration,validUntil,businessReceiptId,resultSha256);
        if(status==APPLIED) requireEqual(resultSha256,ProcessTypedJson.sha256("AUTOMATION_WORKER_RESULT_V2",utf8(effectFingerprint),utf8(businessReceiptId),ProcessTypedJson.canonicalBytes(output)));
        output=immutableDeepCopy(output);
    }
}
```

```java
NodeRetryResultDTO retry(ProcessActor actor,String instanceId,@Valid NodeRetryCommand c){
    var original=nodes.findOriginalRetry(actor,instanceId,c);
    if(original.isPresent()) return original.get();
    var query=deriveVerifiedExactNode(actor,instanceId,c);
    var proof=requireTrustedObserverOutsideTransaction(query);
    return transaction.execute(tx->{
        bindings.lockRoot(actor.tenantId(),instanceId);
        return replayOrInsertFrozenAttempt(actor,c,query,proof,databaseNow());
    });
}
boolean permitsRecovery(WorkerEffectRecoveryProofVO p,ProcessNodeExecutionBO node,Instant now){
    return p.matchesExactFrozenEffect(node)&&now.isBefore(node.getNodeDeadlineAt())&&now.isBefore(p.validUntil())&&(p.status()==APPLIED||p.status()==NOT_APPLIED_FINAL);
}
```

```java
void verifyRecoveryCompletion(AutomationWorkerTaskDTO task,AutomationWorkerCompletionCommand c){

    if(proof!=null&&proof.mode()==REPLAY_APPLIED) {
        requireEqual(proof.businessReceiptId(),c.getBusinessReceiptId());

    }
}
```

```java
HttpInputMessage beforeBodyRead(HttpInputMessage in,MethodParameter parameter,Type type,Class<? extends HttpMessageConverter<?>> c){
    int max=boundedSizeForExactStepCommand(type);
    if(in.getHeaders().getContentLength()>max) throw new TooLarge();
    byte[] bytes=in.getBody().readNBytes(max+1);
    if(bytes.length>max) throw new TooLarge();
    validateClosedStepJson(type,strictJackson.readTree(bytes));
    return replayableInput(in,bytes);
}
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE tianji_process_event_inbox (
    tenant_id bigint NOT NULL,
    producer_issuer char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    producer_subject varchar(256) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    event_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    receipt_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    fingerprint char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    route_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    route_version bigint NOT NULL,
    route_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    release_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    mode varchar(8) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    command_id varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    wait_token_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C",
    payload jsonb NOT NULL,
    correlation_key varchar(255) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    state varchar(24) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    instance_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C",
    node_execution_ref varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    received_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    decided_at timestamptz,
    next_retry_at timestamptz,
    attempts integer NOT NULL,
    decision_code varchar(64) COLLATE "C",
    definition_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    activation_revision bigint NOT NULL,
    admitted_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    admission_not_after timestamptz(6),
    admission_json jsonb,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,producer_issuer,producer_subject,event_id),
    CHECK (activation_revision > 0),
    CHECK (state IN ('RECEIVED','APPLIED','IGNORED_LATE','REJECTED','DEAD'))
);

CREATE TABLE tianji_process_event_subscription (
    tenant_id bigint NOT NULL,
    token_sha256 char(64) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    instance_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    parent_scope_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    target_node_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    reservation_id uuid NOT NULL,
    route_key varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    route_version bigint NOT NULL,
    source_ref varchar(128) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    native_execution_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C",
    native_subscription_id varchar(255) COLLATE "C",
    node_execution_ref varchar(128) COLLATE "C",
    state varchar(16) COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    revision bigint NOT NULL,
    deadline_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    closed_at timestamptz,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,token_sha256),
    CHECK (state IN ('RESERVED','BOUND','CONSUMED','CLOSED')),
    CHECK (deadline_at > created_at)
);

ALTER TABLE tianji_process_event_inbox ADD CONSTRAINT process_event_receipt_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,receipt_id);
ALTER TABLE tianji_process_event_inbox ADD CONSTRAINT event_instance_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,instance_id) REFERENCES tianji_process_instance_binding (tenant_id,instance_id) ON DELETE NO ACTION;
ALTER TABLE tianji_process_event_inbox ADD CONSTRAINT event_activation_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,definition_key,activation_revision,release_key) REFERENCES tianji_process_automation_activation (tenant_id,definition_key,revision,release_key) ON DELETE NO ACTION;
ALTER TABLE tianji_process_event_subscription ADD CONSTRAINT event_reservation_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,reservation_id);
ALTER TABLE tianji_process_event_subscription ADD CONSTRAINT subscription_instance_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,instance_id) REFERENCES tianji_process_instance_binding (tenant_id,instance_id) ON DELETE NO ACTION;
CREATE INDEX process_event_pending_idx ON tianji_process_event_inbox (next_retry_at,tenant_id,receipt_id) WHERE state='RECEIVED';
CREATE INDEX process_event_wait_idx ON tianji_process_event_inbox (tenant_id,wait_token_sha256,received_at) WHERE mode='SIGNAL' AND state='RECEIVED';
ALTER TABLE tianji_process_instance_binding ADD CONSTRAINT instance_event_source_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,source_event_receipt_id) REFERENCES tianji_process_event_inbox (tenant_id,receipt_id) ON DELETE NO ACTION;
CREATE INDEX event_subscription_scope_idx ON tianji_process_event_subscription (tenant_id,instance_id,parent_scope_id,target_node_id) WHERE state IN ('RESERVED','BOUND');
```

```java
ProcessEventReceiptDTO receiveStart(ProcessActor producer,@Valid ProcessEventCommand c){
    var original=inbox.findOriginal(producer,c);
    if(original.isPresent()) return exactReplay(original.get(),c);
    var proof=observeEventAdmissionOutsideTransaction(producer,c);
    return transaction.execute(tx->{
        PlatformReleaseTenantFence.acquireShared(jdbc,producer.tenantId());
        return verifyCurrentActivationThenInsertAdmission(producer,c,proof);
    });
}
```

```java
StartResult startAdmittedEvent(ProcessEventAdmissionVO admission){
    return transaction.execute(tx->{
        PlatformReleaseTenantFence.acquireShared(jdbc,admission.tenantId());
        var row=eventInbox.lockExact(admission.receiptId());
        var prior=receipts.findAppliedEventStart(row);
        if(prior.isPresent()) return recoverOriginalApplied(row,prior.get());
        return startPinnedUnderAdmission(row,databaseNow());
    });
}
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
HttpInputMessage beforeBodyRead(HttpInputMessage in,MethodParameter parameter,Type type,Class<? extends HttpMessageConverter<?>> c){
    int max=boundedSizeForExactStepCommand(type);
    if(in.getHeaders().getContentLength()>max) throw new TooLarge();
    byte[] bytes=in.getBody().readNBytes(max+1);
    if(bytes.length>max) throw new TooLarge();
    validateClosedStepJson(type,strictJackson.readTree(bytes));
    return replayableInput(in,bytes);
}
```

```java
void applySignal(EventInboxBO event,EventSubscriptionBO reservation){

}
```
