```java
HttpInputMessage beforeBodyRead(HttpInputMessage in,MethodParameter parameter,Type type,Class<? extends HttpMessageConverter<?>> c){
    int max=boundedSizeForExactStepCommand(type);
    if(in.getHeaders().getContentLength()>max) throw new TooLarge();
    byte[] bytes=in.getBody().readNBytes(max+1);
    if(bytes.length>max) throw new TooLarge();
    validateClosedStepJson(type,strictJackson.readTree(bytes));
    return replayableInput(in,bytes);
```
```java
}
```

```java
void applyTypedTerminal(AgentTerminalEventV2 terminal){
    transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx->{
        var root=locateVerifiedRoot(terminal);
        bindings.lockRoot(root.tenantId(),root.instanceId());
        var wait=inspector.requireExactTypedWait(terminal,root);
        acceptAndApplyOnlyIfCurrent(wait,terminal,databaseNow());
    });
}
```

```java
@Test void switchesOnlyLosslesslyAndReplaysEveryOriginalCommand() {
  var history = insertV10FixtureWithSharedKeysAndEscapedLargeContent();
  var cut = migration.freezeAndMigrate(history.scope(), history.originalEpoch());
  assertThat(cut.storageRef()).isEqualTo(COMPONENT);
  assertThat(replayAllOldCommandReceipts(history)).containsExactlyElementsOf(history.originalResults());
  assertThat(readCurrentMemoryAfterIndexReplay(cut)).doesNotContainAnyElementsOf(history.redactedFacts());
  assertThat(queryExactLegacyPhysicalVectors(cut)).isEmpty();
  forgetAndExpireUnderComponentAuthority(cut);
  assertThat(queryLegacyRevisionsWithPlainContentOrSource(cut)).isEmpty();
  assertThat(replayAllOldCommandReceipts(history)).containsExactlyElementsOf(history.originalResults());
}
@Test void refusesCutWithPhysicalOrphanOrFailedDeletion() {
  injectScopedOrphanOrForceLegacyPhysicalDeleteFailure();
  assertThatThrownBy(() -> migration.freezeAndMigrate(scope, epoch)).hasMessageContaining("unavailable");
  assertThat(readAuthoritativeStorageRef(scope)).isEqualTo(LEGACY);
}
```

```typescript
const v2 = '/api/tianji/v2';
const draftPath = (draftId: string) => v2 + '/process-drafts/' + encodeURIComponent(assertDraftId(draftId));
const processDraftsApi = {
  validate: (tenant, body, signal) => write(v2 + '/process-model-validations', tenant, 'POST', validateRevision(body), signal, parseValidation),
  publish: (tenant, body, signal) => write(v2 + '/process-releases', tenant, 'POST', validatePublication(body), signal, parsePublication),
  create: (tenant, definitionKey, body, signal) => write(v2 + '/process-definitions/' + segment(definitionKey) + '/drafts', tenant, 'POST', validateCreation(body), signal, parseSummary),
  get: (tenant, draftId, commandId, signal) => read(withQuery(draftPath(draftId), {commandId}), tenant, signal, parseCurrentDraftAndReceipt),
  list: (tenant, query, signal) => read(withQuery(v2 + '/process-drafts', checkDraftQuery(query)), tenant, signal, parseDraftPage),
  save: (tenant, draftId, body, signal) => write(draftPath(draftId), tenant, 'PUT', checkRawSaveBody(body, 4 * 1024 ** 2, 5 * 1024 ** 2), signal, parseMutationReceipt),
  discard: (tenant, draftId, body, signal) => write(draftPath(draftId) + '/discard-commands', tenant, 'POST', validateDiscard(body), signal, parseMutationReceipt),
};
```

#### File 6 — `CREATE src/api/processAutomation.ts`

- Purpose: 实现流程运行客户端与独立原请求摘要。
- Symbols: AutomationStartCommand, AutomationInstanceDTO, GraphVO, NodeExecutionPageDTO, ProcessControlSnapshotDTO, CancelProcessCommand, processAutomationApi.
- Repository evidence: client.ts requestJson和旧processCorrelations.ts exactObject；原v1取消OpenAPI在CL process-control-v1.json。
- Dependencies and consumers: 工作区START、Instance页、Node面板；sessionStorage归页面，不在客户端持久化。
- Why now: 在相关测试已锁定边界后接入本文件，验证processAutomation.test.ts运行路径、精确字节与旧取消兼容。
- Contract/signature changes: start(tenant,command,signal) POST /api/tianji/v2/process-instances；get同前缀加/{instanceId}；listNodeExecutions再加/node-executions；retryNode POST再加/node-retries。getControl(tenant,instanceId,signal) GET /api/tianji/v1/process-instances/{instanceId}/control；cancel(tenant,instanceId,{instanceId,commandId,expectedVersion,reason},signal) POST /api/tianji/v1/process-instances/{instanceId}/cancellations。
- Input/output and state mapping: API-004/005闭合响应含实际releaseVersion/activationRevision/graph/output/availableActions；API-006 items以nodeId/occurrenceId/attempt和不透明version定位；API-011输入nodeExecutionRef/expectedVersion/reason/businessReceiptRef，202只接受SCHEDULED。startRequestSha256对实际将发送的五个内容段计算，commandId不在摘要，只有省略overrides归一{}。
- Error and edge behavior: 禁传releaseVersion/channel/activationRevision、tenant或凭据；非精确整数和无效Unicode在发出之前失败；状态未知不自动写，400/409/503保留原码；GET游标错误由页面回首屏。取消按原200闭合instanceId/commandId/accepted/status/resultingVersion/finishedAt/decidedAt/linkedAgentClosureScheduled，结果accepted=false可为终态无操作。
- Cancellation control snapshot: 按原 OAS 闭合解析 instance/activeWaits/availableActions/blockReason/version/observedAt，核验 instanceId，原控制 version 仅用于取消。
- Standards impact: MC-JSON-001、MC-VALID-001、MC-REUSE-001，沿已认证requestJson和闭合运行时校验。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 11。客户端复用现有transport与原授权上下文。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```typescript
const prefix = '/api/tianji/v2/process-instances';
const detailPath = (instanceId: string) => prefix + '/' + segment(instanceId);
async function startRequestSha256(command: AutomationStartCommand): Promise<string> {
  const checked = assertExactStartWire(command);
  const overrides = Object.hasOwn(checked, 'agentTaskOverrides') ? assertRecord(checked.agentTaskOverrides) : {};
  const utf8 = new TextEncoder();
  const segments = ['AUTOMATION_START_REQUEST_V2', checked.definitionKey, checked.businessKey,
    checked.correlationId, canonicalTypedJson(checked.variables), canonicalTypedJson(overrides)].map(value => utf8.encode(value));
  return lowerHex(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', joinU32LengthPrefixedSegments(segments)));
}
const processAutomationApi = {
  start: (tenant, body, signal) => write(prefix, tenant, 'POST', assertExactStartWire(body), signal, parseInstance),
  get: (tenant, instanceId, signal) => read(detailPath(instanceId), tenant, signal, parseInstance),
  listNodeExecutions: (tenant, instanceId, query, signal) => read(withQuery(detailPath(instanceId) + '/node-executions', checkNodeQuery(query)), tenant, signal, parseNodePage),
  retryNode: (tenant, instanceId, body, signal) => write(detailPath(instanceId) + '/node-retries', tenant, 'POST', checkRetryCommand(body), signal, parseScheduled),
  getControl: (tenant, instanceId, signal) => read('/api/tianji/v1/process-instances/' + segment(instanceId) + '/control',
    tenant, signal, parseV1Control),
  cancel: (tenant, instanceId, body, signal) => write('/api/tianji/v1/process-instances/' + segment(instanceId) + '/cancellations',
    tenant, 'POST', checkV1Cancellation(instanceId, body), signal, parseV1Cancellation),
};
function canonicalObject(object: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  return '{' + Object.keys(object).sort().map(key => escapeCheckedString(key) + ':' + canonicalTypedJson(object[key])).join(',') + '}';
}
```

```typescript
async function getReceipt(tenant: string, receiptId: string, signal?: AbortSignal) {
  const path = '/api/tianji/v2/process-event-receipts/' + segment(assertReceiptId(receiptId));

  return parseReceiptWithExactKeysAndState(raw, receiptId);
}
```

```typescript
useEffect(() => {
  const request = new AbortController();
  void processDraftsApi.list(tenant, {definitionKey, state, limit: 20}, request.signal)
    .then(page => { if (isCurrent(request, epoch)) setDraftPage(page); })
    .catch(failure => { if (isCurrent(request, epoch)) setReadFailure(failure); });
  return () => request.abort();
}, [tenant, epoch, definitionKey, state]);
async function createDraft(values: CreateFields) {
  const body = {title: values.title, baseReleaseVersion: values.baseReleaseVersion ?? null, commandId: newCommandId()};
  saveScopedCreatePointer(identity, {definitionKey: values.definitionKey, ...body});
  const draft = await processDraftsApi.create(tenant, values.definitionKey, body, signal);
  if (isCurrent(signal, epoch)) navigate('/process-definitions/drafts/' + segment(draft.draftId));
}
```

```tsx
const layout = layoutSafeGraph(graph.nodes, graph.edges);
return <svg aria-label="流程逻辑图" viewBox={layout.viewBox}>
  {layout.edges.map(drawReactLine)}
  {layout.nodes.map(node => <g key={node.id} role="button" tabIndex={0}
    aria-pressed={selectedNodeId === node.id}
    aria-label={accessibleNodeLabel(node, executions)}
    onClick={() => onSelectNode(node.id)}
    onKeyDown={event => { if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
      event.preventDefault();
      onSelectNode(node.id);
    } }}>
      <rect {...node.bounds} /><text>{node.name}</text>
  </g>)}
</svg>;
```

- Input/output and state mapping: 分页行保留版本、期限、状态、inputSha256/outputSchemaSha256和eventReceiptIds；DATA_READ才显示output，API-006没有input正文；DIAGNOSTIC_READ且获AS页面权才链接Run。202 SCHEDULED后由父页重新读取实例和节点。
- Error and edge behavior: 重试要NODE_RETRY、服务端availableActions、WAIT_RECOVERY；deadlineAt是已结束attempt的期限，只作显示，不能用它推断节点总时限；reason 1–512，ref默认null且仅供查证；不接收自证成功。409保持原等待；未知只可用原命令/原body重放。

- Implementation pseudocode:

```typescript
const page = await processAutomationApi.listNodeExecutions(tenant, instanceId, {nodeId, cursor, limit: 20}, signal);
if (isCurrent(signal, epoch)) setNodeRows(appendMatchingPage(page, {instanceId, nodeId, cursor}));
const canRetry = allows('tianji.button.processNode.retry') && instancePageAllowed && row.state === 'WAIT_RECOVERY'
  && rowPermitsRetry(row.availableActions) && !stale;
if (canRetry && confirmed) {
  const body = {commandId, nodeExecutionRef: row.nodeExecutionRef, expectedVersion: row.version,
    reason: checkReason(reason), businessReceiptRef: checkedLookupRefOrNull(businessReceiptRef)};
  const accepted = await processAutomationApi.retryNode(tenant, instanceId, body, signal);
  if (isCurrent(signal, epoch) && accepted.state === 'SCHEDULED') await refreshInstanceAndNodes();
}
```

- Input/output and state mapping: 实例头保存当前version与固定graph；将选中nodeId传SVG和GraphList，子面板回调触发重新读；PROCESS_READ+CANCEL且availableActions含CANCEL时打开取消确认并请求原 v1 control。仅当前 control 也允许 CANCEL 时提交，用精确instanceId/commandId/expectedVersion/reason走原v1，其中expectedVersion取该 control.version。
- Error and edge behavior: 切换身份/tenant/资源先清projection并abort；子面板失败单独提示；服务不可用仅保留脱敏旧读，禁操作；终态不接受迟到响应覆盖。取消成功仍分别观察远端Agent停止。

- Implementation pseudocode:

```typescript
useEffect(() => {
  const request = new AbortController();
  clearForNewIdentityOrInstance();
  void processAutomationApi.get(tenant, instanceId, request.signal)
    .then(snapshot => { if (isCurrent(request, epoch)) setSnapshot(snapshot); })
    .catch(error => { if (isCurrent(request, epoch)) setSafeFailure(error); });
  return () => request.abort();
}, [tenant, epoch, instanceId]);
const canCancel = allows('tianji.button.processInstance.cancel') && snapshot.availableActions.includes('CANCEL') && !stale;
const selectNode = (nodeId: string) => setSearchParams({nodeId});
if (canCancel && confirmation.opened) {
  const control = await processAutomationApi.getControl(tenant, instanceId, signal);
  if (isCurrent(signal, epoch)) showCancellationControl(control);
}
if (canCancel && confirmation.accepted && control.availableActions.includes('CANCEL')) {
  const body = {instanceId, commandId, expectedVersion: control.version, reason};
  retainOriginalCancellationWhileUnknown(body);
  await processAutomationApi.cancel(tenant, instanceId, body, signal);
  await refreshInstanceAndNodePage();
}
```

```typescript
async function submitStart(values: StartValues) {
  if (!allows('tianji.button.processDefinitions.start') || inFlight.current) return;
  const body = retryIntent ? retryIntent.exactOriginalBody
    : toExactStartCommand(parseValidatedTypedInput(values), newCommandId());
  const originalRequestSha256 = await startRequestSha256(body);
  if (retryIntent && originalRequestSha256 !== retryIntent.requestSha256) return setUnknown();
  saveScopedStartPointer(identity, {commandId: body.commandId, requestSha256: originalRequestSha256});
  setRetryIntent({exactOriginalBody: body, requestSha256: originalRequestSha256});
  const created = await processAutomationApi.start(tenant, body, signal);
  if (isCurrent(signal, epoch)) setConfirmedStart({instanceId: created.instanceId,
    releaseVersion: created.releaseVersion, activationRevision: created.activationRevision});
}
async function recoverStart(pointer: ProcessStartReceiptQuery) {
  const receipt = await processStartReceiptsApi.get(tenant, pointer, signal);
  if (isCurrent(signal, epoch) && receipt.status === 'APPLIED') navigate('/process-instances/' + segment(receipt.instanceId));
}
```

#### File 4 — `CREATE src/pages/ProcessDraftEditorPage.tsx`

- Purpose: 实现可恢复的固定修订草稿编辑器。
- Symbols: ProcessDraftEditorPage, DraftEditorState, SaveDraftAction, ValidateSavedRevisionAction, PublishAction, DiscardDraftAction, recoveryPointerKey.
- Repository evidence: 复用现有AntD TextArea/Form/Modal及API模块；工作区仅提供draftId深链。
- Dependencies and consumers: 复用已交付的Step 43生效面板、Step 42安全图和列表，Step 45在两者后登记深链。
- Why now: 在相关测试已锁定边界后接入本文件，验证ProcessDraftEditorPage.test.tsx验证不覆盖新编辑与未知恢复。
- Contract/signature changes: 路径读draftId，get(tenant,draftId,commandId?,signal)读取current及命令receipt；save、validate、publish、discard使用API-020/001/002/022。
- Input/output and state mapping: 状态分saved、buffer、saving/unknown/conflict、validation、publication；支持BPMN/DMN原始XML、schema/binding/route原始JSON文本；错误定位issue.path/nodeId。暂存传title/content，预检传revision/hash，发布加releaseVersion/commandId。校验成功且未dirty才可确认发布。
- Error and edge behavior: 409保留buffer，显式重载；只有当前epoch且返回目标revision/hash一致才显示预检；PUBLISHED/DISCARDED禁写；未知保存只用内存原请求重放，刷新以API-019查证。通过prepareDraftSave后才保存小型sessionStorage指针。使用React Router数据路由离页拦截和浏览器刷新提示，编辑器测试用createMemoryRouter，Step 45接入App路由；正文不落盘。
- Standards impact: MC-REUSE-001、MC-SCOPE-001，沿既有React、AntD和CSS交互边界。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 11。沿现有Web目录与Router/AntD入口实现。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```tsx
const captured = {title: buffer.title, content: exactDraftContent(buffer), expectedRevision: saved.revision, commandId: newCommandId()};
prepareDraftSave(draftId, captured);
const bufferGenerationAtSend = bufferGeneration.current;
saveScopedDraftPointer(identity, {operation: 'SAVE', draftId, commandId: captured.commandId,
  expectedRevision: captured.expectedRevision, expectedContentSha256: saved.contentSha256});
const receipt = await processDraftsApi.save(tenant, draftId, captured, signal);
if (isCurrent(signal, epoch)) {
  setSaved(toSavedSnapshot(captured, receipt));
  setValidation(undefined);
  if (bufferGenerationAtSend === bufferGeneration.current) setBuffer(toEditorBuffer(captured));
}
const validation = await processDraftsApi.validate(tenant, {draftId, expectedRevision: saved.revision,
  expectedContentSha256: saved.contentSha256}, signal);
if (matchesSavedRevisionAndEpoch(validation, saved, epoch)) setValidation(validation);
const publication = await processDraftsApi.publish(tenant, {draftId, expectedRevision: saved.revision,
  expectedContentSha256: saved.contentSha256, releaseVersion, commandId: publishCommandId}, signal);
const recovery = await processDraftsApi.get(tenant, draftId, pendingPointer.commandId, signal);
if (!recovery.commandReceipt) setUnknownWithoutOverwritingBuffer();
const canPublish = saved.state === 'EDITING' && !dirty && isValidForSavedRevision(validation, saved);
if (validation?.graph && !dirty) renderValidationGraphAndList(validation.graph, selectedNodeId, setSelectedNodeId);
if (publication) render(<ProcessActivationPanel definitionKey={saved.definitionKey}
  releaseVersion={publication.releaseVersion} baseReleaseVersion={saved.baseReleaseVersion} />);
```

```java
@EnabledIfSystemProperty(named = "tianji.automation.acceptance.required", matches = "true")
final class AutomationIndependentServicesIT {
    @BeforeAll static void openFixture() {
        manifest = AutomationAcceptanceManifestVO.read(Path.of(requireProperty("tianji.automation.acceptance.manifest")));
        fixture = AutomationAcceptanceHarness.open(manifest);
        fixture.launchAll(); // 独立PID + 同版本Boot/JDK + readiness只读证明；失败即终止
    }
    @AfterAll static void closeFixture() {
        if (fixture == null) return;
        try {
            fixture.writeEvidence(fixture.completedScenarioWitnesses());
        } finally {
            fixture.close();
        }
    }

    @Test void human_only() {
        var witnesses = new ArrayList<ScenarioWitnessVO>();
        for (var tenant : fixture.tenants()) {
            var draft = createAndSave(tenant.publisher(), humanOnlyBpmn(), onlyTaskOutputSchema());
            var release = validateAndPublish(tenant.publisher(), draft, draft.revision());
            activate(tenant.activator(), release, 0);
            var instance = automation(tenant.requester()).start(start(release.definitionKey(), key("human"), Map.of()));
            var task = awaitTaskCreatedAndGet(tenant.candidate(), instance, "review");
            var resultRef = fixture.businessForm().persistOnce(tenant, task, "fixture-choice");
            claimViaExistingEndpoint(tenant.candidate(), task);
            var command = complete(key("complete"), currentTaskVersion(task), resultRef, Map.of("decision", true));
            var receipt = automation(tenant.candidate()).completeTask(task.taskId(), command);
            assertEquals(receipt, automation(tenant.candidate()).completeTask(task.taskId(), command));
            assertCompletedExactlyOnce(instance, release, resultRef);
            assertBusinessFormStoredOnlyInBusinessDb(tenant, resultRef, 1);
            assertWrongCandidateCannotReadOrComplete(tenant, task, command);
            witnesses.add(fixture.captureHumanWitness(tenant, instance, receipt, resultRef));
        }
        fixture.recordCompletedScenario("human_only", witnesses);
    }

    @Test void business_event_automation() {
        var definition = publishAndActivate(bpmn("lookup", "fixed-rule", "parallel-write-a-b", "wait-event", "merge"),
                schemas(), fixedDmnAndTypedWorkers());
        var startEvent = signedProducerEvent(definition, "ORDER_CREATED", stableEventKey(), orderInput());
        var eventReceipt = events(producer()).ingest(startEvent);
        assertSameEventReceipt(eventReceipt, events(producer()).ingest(startEvent));
        var instance = awaitBoundInstance(eventReceipt);
        assertReleaseAndRuleDigest(instance, definition);
        var wait = awaitPersistedWait(instance, "wait-event");
        var signal = signedSignal(wait.token(), stableEventKey(), Map.of("paid", true));
        events(producer()).ingest(signal);
        events(producer()).ingest(signal);
        assertTerminalWithMergedOutputs(instance, "a", "b");
        assertOneLocalEffectReceiptPerKeyAndBusinessCount(instance, 2);
        assertNoAdditionalInstancesForEvent(startEvent);
        fixture.recordCompletedScenario("business_event_automation", instance, eventReceipt);
    }

        assertBranchAfterHumanCompletion(definition, "ok", "automatic");
        assertBranchAfterHumanCompletion(definition, "manual", "review");

    }

        assertOrderedFixedAgentRuns(execute(release), "A", "B", "C");
        var variant = publishAndActivate(andXorLoopThreeBpmn(), schemas(), templatesV1());
        var instance = executeWithTemplateOverride(variant, "B", permittedOverride());
        assertBothParallelResultsAndOnlySelectedXor(instance);
        assertThreeDistinctOccurrencesAndInputOutputChain(instance);

    @Test void published_and_active_versions_are_independent() {
        var v1 = publishAndActivate(versionedBpmn(1), schemas(), dependenciesV1());
        var a = startAndWaitAtHuman(v1);
        var original = readProvenance(a);
        var draft = copyFromV2ProfileRelease(v1);
        saveIncompleteSourceAndReopenFromAnotherClientSession(draft);
        assertSameSourceAndDeployment(v1);
        assertSameActivation(v1);
        var v2 = publishFixedDraftRevision(completeSource(draft, versionedBpmn(2)), dependenciesV2());
        assertIndependentActivationDeniedForPublishOnly(v2);
        assertStartsOn(v1);
        var oldEvent = acceptEventAndPauseBeforeInstanceCreation(v1);
        activateExactlyOnce(v2, currentActivationRevision());
        assertDelayedEventStillStartsOn(oldEvent, v1);
        assertFirstNewEventStartsOn(v2);
        assertOriginalReceiptAfterEventInboxResponseLossAndExpiry(oldEvent, v1);
        var b = startAndWaitAtHuman(v2);
        completeHumanAndAwaitBoundDependencies(a, original, dependenciesV1());
        assertOriginalStartCommandReturns(a);
        activateExactlyOnce(v1, currentActivationRevision());
        assertStartsOn(v1);
        completeHumanAndAwaitBoundDependencies(b, readProvenance(b), dependenciesV2());
        fixture.recordCompletedScenario("published_and_active_versions_are_independent", original, a, b);
    }

    @Test void each_owner_recovers_at_persisted_cuts() {
        // 每个位置单独启动一个有唯一键的实例，等待真实DB witness + cut barrier，强制退出并启动新PID。
        for (var cut : List.of(PS_BEFORE_DISPATCH, PS_AFTER_LINKED_ACCEPT_BEFORE_ACK,
                AS_AFTER_RUN_PERSISTED_BEFORE_EXECUTION, AS_AFTER_TERMINAL_BEFORE_DELIVERY,
                WORKER_AFTER_EXTERNAL_APPLIED_BEFORE_REPORT, PS_AFTER_INBOX_COMMIT_BEFORE_APPLY)) {
            var scenario = startWithArmedCut(cut);
            var before = fixture.awaitDurableCut(scenario, cut);
            fixture.replaceChildAtCut(cut.owner());
            assertOriginalReceiptAndPersistedBoundary(scenario, before);
            if (cut == WORKER_AFTER_EXTERNAL_APPLIED_BEFORE_REPORT) {
                assertWorkerWaitRecoveryAndUnknownWithoutAnotherAttempt(scenario);
                assertExternalBusinessEffectCount(scenario, 1);
                assertExactExternalRequestCount(scenario, 1); // 独立入站次数，幂等表不能掩盖未经授权的重发
                exerciseApprovedAuthoritativeRecoveryPaths(scenario); // APPLIED原结果；独立NOT_APPLIED_FINAL用例冻结一代
            } else {
                assertExactlyOneProcessAdvanceAndPinnedResult(scenario);
            }
        }
        assertWorkerAckLossReplaysSameLeaseCommandAndBusinessReceipt();
        assertAgentResultReplayPreservesExactEventBytesAndOneApplication();
        fixture.recordCompletedScenario("each_owner_recovers_at_persisted_cuts", fixture.cutWitnesses());
    }

    @Test void foreign_owner_and_late_results_cannot_apply() {
        var instance = executeUntilWaiting();
        assertForeignTenantSubjectAndForeignInstanceDenied(instance);
        assertWrongReleaseHashAndSchemaHaveNoReceiptOrBusinessEffect(instance);
        // 实际子进程测试到期后的迟到；严格微秒等值在TEST-007专用PG屏障判别。
        assertExpiredDeadlineRejectedAgainstDbInstant(instance);
        cancelThroughOriginalProcessEndpoint(instance);
        replayOriginalLateAgentResult(instance);
        assertCancelledAndNoExtraProgress(instance);
        fixture.recordCompletedScenario("foreign_owner_and_late_results_cannot_apply", instance);
    }
}
```

```java
@Test void rejects_missing_role_duplicate_store_and_public_or_symbolic_paths() {

    assertNoLiveChildren();
}
@Test void rejects_cut_without_persisted_witness_and_redacts_failure_evidence() {

        assertThrows(AssertionError.class, () -> harness.awaitDurableCut(scenario, PS_AFTER_INBOX_COMMIT_BEFORE_APPLY));
    }

    assertNoLiveChildren();
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
record AutomationAcceptanceManifestVO(int schemaVersion, boolean runAuthorized, String runId,
        Path checkoutRoot, Path privateRoot, Path outputDirectory, Map<String,String> revisions,
        List<CandidateLockVO> candidates, List<StoreLockVO> stores, List<TenantFixtureVO> tenants,
        LoopbackTlsFilesVO loopbackTls, int phaseTimeoutSeconds) {
    AutomationAcceptanceManifestVO {
        candidates = List.copyOf(candidates);
        stores = List.copyOf(stores);
        tenants = List.copyOf(tenants);
        revisions = Map.copyOf(revisions);
        requireExactEnumCoverage(candidates, Role.class, CandidateLockVO::role);
        requireExactEnumCoverage(stores, Role.class, StoreLockVO::role);
        requireDistinctLoopbackCatalogs(stores);
        requireDistinctTenantIdsIssuersAndFixedBindings(tenants, 2);
    }
    static AutomationAcceptanceManifestVO read(Path file) {
        requirePrivatePosixFileAndParents(file); // canonical absolute, no links, owner, 0600/0700
        var closedTree = strictMapper().readTree(readAtMost(file, 64 * 1024));
        requireExactManifestKeys(closedTree);
        var candidate = strictMapper().treeToValue(closedTree, AutomationAcceptanceManifestVO.class);
        requireEquals(1, candidate.schemaVersion());
        requireTrue(candidate.runAuthorized());
        requireMatching(candidate.runId(), "[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}");
        requireRange(candidate.phaseTimeoutSeconds(), 5, 90);
        candidate.verifyPrivateInputPathsAndCandidateDigests();
        return candidate;
    }
}
```

```java
@Slf4j
final class AutomationAcceptanceHarness implements AutoCloseable {
    static AutomationAcceptanceHarness open(AutomationAcceptanceManifestVO manifest) {
        verifyThreeRepositoryRevisionsAndArtifactLocks(manifest);
        var stores = connectReadOnlyObserversAndSeparateBusinessSetup(manifest);
        verifyCatalogRolesAndNoSharedDatabaseIdentity(stores);
        // 两个Outbox的各自历史、Flowable版本、pgvector与精确SQL checksum均按owner查询。
        requireMigrationPrefix(stores.process(), "tianji_process.tianji_process_schema_history", 15);
        requireMigrationPrefix(stores.agent(), "tianji_agent.flyway_schema_history", 18);
        requireMigrationPrefix(stores.worker(), "tianji_worker.tianji_worker_schema_history", 3);
        verifyNativeOutboxPgvectorAndPinnedFlywayDigests(stores, manifest);
        createEmptyBusinessFixtureTablesInWorkerDatabaseOnly(stores.businessSetup(), manifest.runId());
        return new AutomationAcceptanceHarness(manifest, stores, ProcessBuilderLauncher.localJdk25());
    }

    void launchAll() {
        try {
            startScopedTlsRelays(); // 精确 method+path+tenant+command；response drop保留字节，默认直通
            for (Role role : List.of(PROCESS, AGENT, WORKER)) {
                start(role, writePrivateRoleProperties(role, randomLoopbackEndpoint(role)));
            }
            awaitDistinctReadyPidsAndProductHealth();
        } catch (RuntimeException failure) {
            close();
            throw failure;
        }
    }

    CutWitnessVO awaitDurableCut(ScenarioVO scenario, Cut cut) {
        return awaitBounded(cut, () -> {
            var marker = faultRelays.exactMarker(cut, scenario);
            var committed = stores.findOwnerWitness(cut, scenario); // 独立连接且不修改PS/AS/W账本
            return marker.isPresent() && committed.isPresent()
                    ? Optional.of(matchExactOwnerCommandCutAndDbTime(marker.get(), committed.get()))
                    : Optional.empty();
        });
    }

    void replaceChildAtCut(Role role) {
        var old = requireRoleHasObservedCut(role);
        forceKillAndRequireExit(old);
        var replacement = start(role, requireSameCandidateDatabaseAndStableRoute(role, old));
        requireDistinctProcessIdentity(old, replacement);
        awaitRoleReady(replacement);
        releaseOnlyMatchingCutBarrier(role);
    }

    void writeEvidence(List<ScenarioWitnessVO> witnesses) {
        // 成功记录必须含测试名、UTC时刻、非零进程和版本、实际receipt及计数；报告不含配置、payload、认证头。
        requireEachRecordedScenarioHasAllExpectedWitnesses(witnesses);
        var status = hasExactSevenScenarioWitnesses(witnesses) ? PASS : INCOMPLETE;
        writeOwnerOnlyAtomically("automation-" + manifest.runId() + ".json", strictEvidenceJson(status, witnesses));
    }

    @Override public void close() {
        stopChildrenInReverseOrderWithBoundedGraceAndForce();
        closeRelaysAndReleaseAllTestLocks();
        closeObserversAndDeleteOnlyTemporaryChildConfigs();
    }
}
```

```java
@Slf4j
public final class AutomationWorkerAcceptanceMain {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        var locked = requirePrivateSettings(args, "WORKER", "tianji_it_automation_w_");
        installPinnedLoopbackTrust(locked);
        var context = new SpringApplicationBuilder(FixtureConfiguration.class)
                .web(WebApplicationType.NONE).properties(onlyAllowedBootProperties(locked)).run();
        assertTrue(context.getBean(RemoteWorkerPoller.class).isRunning());
        writePrivateReadyWithPidAndCandidate(locked, ProcessHandle.current());
        awaitShutdownSignal();
    }
    @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
    @Import(TianjiWorkerAutoConfiguration.class)
    static class FixtureConfiguration {
        @Bean("automationFixtureTransactionalWrite")
        AutomationWorkerHandlerRegistration transactionalWrite(@Qualifier("automationFixtureLock") FixtureLock lock) {
            AutomationTransactionalWorkerHandler handler = (input, jdbc) -> {
                requireBoundSourceTenantAndSchema(lock, input);
                var digest = canonicalFixtureInputHash(input.input());
                var effect = insertOrReadExactSamePayload(jdbc, lock.runId(), input.tenantId(), input.effectKey(), digest);
                return typedOutput(effect.resultRef(), digest);
            };
            return register(lock.transactionalDescriptor(), handler);
        }
        @Bean("automationFixtureExternalWrite")
        AutomationWorkerHandlerRegistration externalWrite(@Qualifier("automationFixtureRelay") FixtureRelay relay) {
            AutomationNonTransactionalWorkerHandler handler = (input, effectKey) ->
                    relay.callExactExternalTarget(input, effectKey); // 持久副作用由fixture外部端事务提交
            return register(relay.externalDescriptor(), handler);
        }
        // readOnlyLookup通过第三个具名registration查询固定fixture记录，不写业务效果。
    }
}
```

```sh
[ "$#" -eq 2 ] || exit 64
case "$2" in /*) ;; *) exit 64 ;; esac
: "${JAVA_HOME:?Use JDK 25}"
automation_java_major=$("$JAVA_HOME/bin/java" -XshowSettings:properties -version 2>&1 |
  awk -F'= ' '/java.specification.version/{print $2; exit}')
[ "$automation_java_major" = 25 ] || exit 65
umask 077
automation_stamp=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tianji-automation-report.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$automation_stamp"' EXIT
case "$1" in
  prepare)
    STELLAR_VERIFY_GOAL=verify sh scripts/verify-source-reactor.sh -B -ntp \
      -DskipTests=false -DskipITs=true -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
      -Dtest=AutomationAcceptanceHarnessTest,AutomationWorkerAcceptanceClasspathTest,WorkerDependencyBoundaryTest \
      -Dtianji.automation.acceptance.prepare=true "-Dtianji.automation.acceptance.workerClasspath=$2"
    set -- AutomationAcceptanceHarnessTest:3 AutomationWorkerAcceptanceClasspathTest:1 WorkerDependencyBoundaryTest:1
    ;;
  run)
    STELLAR_VERIFY_GOAL=test sh scripts/verify-source-reactor.sh -B -ntp \
      -DskipTests=false -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false -Dtest=AutomationIndependentServicesIT \
      -Dtianji.automation.acceptance.required=true "-Dtianji.automation.acceptance.manifest=$2"
    set -- AutomationIndependentServicesIT:7
    ;;
  *) exit 64 ;;
esac
python3 - "$automation_stamp" "$@" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from sys import argv
from xml.etree import ElementTree

stamp = Path(argv[1]).stat().st_mtime_ns
for selector in argv[2:]:
    name, minimum = selector.split(":")
    reports = [path for path in Path(".").glob("stellar-enclosure-tianji-*/target/surefire-reports/TEST-*.xml")
               if path.name.removesuffix(".xml").endswith("." + name)
               and path.stat().st_mtime_ns >= stamp]
    if len(reports) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"{name}: missing or ambiguous current Surefire report")
    suite = ElementTree.parse(reports[0]).getroot()
    counts = {field: int(suite.attrib[field]) for field in ("tests", "failures", "errors", "skipped")}
    if counts["tests"] < int(minimum) or any(counts[field] for field in ("failures", "errors", "skipped")):
        raise SystemExit(f"{name}: {counts}")
    print(f"{name}: {counts}")
PY
```

```java
}
```

```java
public AgentRunDTO replayCommittedDirectStart(TrustedAgentActor actor, @Valid StartAgentRunCommand command) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(actor, "actor");
    Objects.requireNonNull(command, "command");
    String requestHash = json.requestHash(command);
    var original = repository.byIdempotencyKey(actor, command.idempotencyKey())
            .orElseThrow(AgentLedgerService::notFound);
    return sameRequest(original, requestHash);
}
```

```java
this.legacyDirectStartEnabled =
        environment.getProperty("stellar.tianji.agent.legacy.direct-start.enabled", Boolean.class, true);

// 已通过对应根POST或with-session的原permission及命令形态校验。
private AgentRunDTO start(TianjiAgentAccess.Authorized authorized, StartAgentRunCommand command) {
    if (!legacyDirectStartEnabled) {
        return ledger.replayCommittedDirectStart(authorized.actor(), command);
    }
    AgentRunDTO run = ledger.start(authorized.actor(), command);
    return executionGrants == null ? run : executionGrants.ensure(authorized, run);
}
```

## 12. Review and Acceptance

### 12.1 Original requirement fidelity

全部 REQ-001–021、四类完整流程、组件独立使用、持久草稿/独立生效/新旧实例隔离、业务承接及预算退役均已映射到有序文件和验收步骤。§4.3、§6.5 及各 Step 的 Subagent execution 共同约束分工、文件归属和提交顺序。

### 12.2 Spec consistency

原四项合同缺口按用户追加授权先修订Spec，再写计划。新增worker/制品证明接口、Memory迁移字段、权限资源与摘要规则均有主Spec具体定义；Plan Clarification只补内部文件、工具链和测试落地细节。使用原Flowable/Worker/Outbox/AF能力，没有参数搬运查询、第二编排入口或新依赖框架。

### 12.3 Repository executability

§5每条路径对应§7有序块；`CREATE`为基线未有文件，`MODIFY/DELETE`为基线文件或明确的先前Step产物。同文件全部前后写者进入依赖边，所有并行批次无文件交集；每步指定真实仓库cwd、精确验证命令和允许提交路径。未来执行若HEAD/文件发生漂移须先对该步重验，不使用本Plan覆盖他人改动。

### 12.4 Test and release completeness

已写明RED/GREEN、真实PG/独立进程/浏览器分层证据、reader-before-writer/schema、既有版本与在途恢复、权限/配置/可选classpath、未知效果、Memory物理清理、旧消费者承接、回退边界和临时脚本归属。全部产品执行仍在后续步骤；Plan审查不替代测试、生产演练或部署验收。

### 12.6 Final verdict

`PASS — Ready for user review`

本结论保留原计划审查记录。用户已确认 §6.5，当前按各 Step 完成门禁推进并分仓提交。

文档验证记录：Spec严格校验通过。Plan严格校验器的全文件占位符正则会将Maven注解处理器配置中合法的XML `path` 元素误报为未解决占位符；该元素属于实际POM结构，含精确groupId/artifactId/version，XML解析与人工核对均确认其含义。原始严格命令因此仍报告这一个误报，不能称为零诊断通过；其余结构、逐文件标记、规则映射、追溯和链接项通过，额外的路径/操作、测试先后及共享文件依赖审计通过。本轮不修改技能校验器，也不把正确XML改为错误配置来消除误报。

## Java / CQE contract review

POJO/VO/enum、逐层Validation、转换器、具名构造注入、UTC、配置同构及复杂模式已由原编号规则和Manual Check分别落实。Command/Query/Event的HTTP/Outbox路径在合同与各宿主步明确；新增事件只沿既有可靠投递，不调用不存在的业务状态机。现有技术身份键、append-only历史与物理效果收据不套用业务软删除；本次无新增软删除业务唯一键，故deleted_at业务NULL/重复删除规则没有新的目标表。普通JDBC/Flyway采用主Spec已授权的技术边界，不引入第二迁移权威。

## Backend generation and dependency evidence

本次不创建新的light/web/service archetype业务模块，亦无适用的CREATE-only CRUD生成任务；所有CREATE/ALTER技术SQL与精确manifest/verifier均在所属Step列出，由既有owner工具安装而应用启动仅验证。AF可选技术四表为显式宿主供给，不注册第二自动runner。编译依赖复用现有BOM/相邻模块已用版本；可选JDBC/RAG依赖已有Spec确认。实际生成输出与SQL hash须在未来执行验证时记录，不把文档伪代码称作已生成文件。
